AI.result: 在TIPS-pentacene中模拟激子-极化激元输运，合理复现了实验观测到的极化激元群速度重整化，其源于声子诱导的非马尔可夫Lamb位移；并表明该重整化在传统马尔可夫理论中无法再现。
AI.conclusion: 该非马尔可夫全量子方法可行且高效，揭示了非马尔可夫效应（Lamb位移）在极化激元输运中的关键作用，为微观理解集体光-物质耦合下的动力学提供了新工具。

title: A subcell-refined entropy-residual-driven limiting strategy for high-order discontinuous Galerkin methods
summary: Fine-grained, subcell-level dissipation control is essential for achieving robust high-order discontinuous Galerkin (DG) simulations of nonlinear hyperbolic systems in under-resolved regimes while preserving accuracy. This paper proposes a subcell-refined entropy-residual-driven limiting strategy for DG on Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto nodes. The limiter introduces only nearest-neighbor pairwise dissipation within each element, with closed-form coefficients that supply the minimal dissipation required to restore the element entropy inequality. The strategy is a diagonal, locally stable approximation of classical entropy-stable methods, and a generalized subcell framework reveals split-form DG and residual-distribution-based entropy correction schemes as particular choices of the limiting coefficients. For the Euler equations, a physically consistent jump operator separately models thermal and shear entropy production while preserving velocity and pressure equilibrium; a subcell refinement of the Zhang-Shu positivity limiter ensures pointwise positivity. Extensive numerical tests confirm that the scheme maintains optimal high-order accuracy, strictly enforces entropy dissipation, and significantly reduces the difficulty of a posteriori positivity-preserving procedures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于子单元细化、熵残差驱动的DG限制器，用最近邻成对耗散与闭式系数实现最小熵耗散，保持高阶精度并简化保正性处理。
AI.motivation: 非线性双曲系统在欠分辨区域的高阶DG模拟需要精细的子单元级耗散控制，以同时保证鲁棒性和精度。
AI.method: 在Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto节点上引入单元内最近邻成对耗散，系数为闭式解以恢复单元熵不等式；作为经典熵稳定方法的对角局部稳定近似，广义子单元框架涵盖分裂形式DG与残差分布熵修正；对Euler方程采用分别建模热与剪切熵产生的跳跃算子，并用子单元细化Zhang-Shu保正限制器。
AI.result: 大量数值测试表明，该格式保持最优高阶精度、严格满足熵耗散，并显著降低后验保正程序的难度。
AI.conclusion: 该子单元熵残差驱动限制策略为高阶DG提供了兼顾精度、鲁棒性与保正性的统一耗散控制框架。

title: Quantitative Classical Relaxation Dynamics of Penning-Ionized He/Ne--H$_2^+$/HD$^+$ Complexes
summary: Penning ionization allows {\it in situ} generation of ionic complexes to launch vibrational relaxation and dissociation dynamics for rare gas--H$_2^+$/HD$^+$ complexes. The ensuing translational kinetic energy release (TKER) spectra characterizing the diatomic cation are a particularly sensitive way to probe the long range part of the intermolecular interactions. TKER distributions from quasi-classical trajectory (QCT) simulations for the Ne--H$_2^+$ and Ne--HD$^+$ complexes quantitatively match measured positions and relative intensities of most experimentally observed features and are also on par with time-dependent quantum simulations. Specifically, the QCT-simulations allow to separate signatures arising from H$_2^+$/HD$^+$ relaxation into different final vibrational states, such as for $(v=2) \rightarrow (v' = 0/1 )$. Trajectory-resolved QCT analysis also provides mechanistic interpretations of the spatial and time-dependent dynamics underlying the TKER distributions. Rare gas--H$_2^+$/HD$^+$ complex lifetimes directly correlate with the final rotational quantum number $j'$ of the diatomic. Low-$j'$ products are associated primarily with an initial axial approach of the rare gas atom, whereas formation of higher-$j'$ states predominantly results from an initial T-shaped approach geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文用准经典轨迹（QCT）模拟稀有气体–H2+/HD+复合物的Penning电离后振动弛豫与解离动力学，TKER谱与实验及量子结果吻合，并揭示j'与初始几何构型的关系。
AI.motivation: Penning电离可原位生成离子复合物，其TKER谱对分子间长程相互作用极为敏感，需要理论与实验结合来解析振动弛豫/解离动力学机制。
AI.method: 对Ne–H2+和Ne–HD+复合物进行准经典轨迹（QCT）模拟，并与时间依赖量子模拟及实验TKER分布对比，进行轨迹分辨分析。
AI.result: QCT的TKER分布在峰位与相对强度上定量符合实验观测，并与量子模拟相当；可分离(v=2)→(v'=0/1)等不同末态振动通道的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 复合物寿命与双原子末态转动量子数j'相关：低j'主要来自稀有气体原子的初始轴向接近，高j'主要来自初始T形接近几何。

title: Rank-dependent optimal resetting in multiparticle search
summary: In many soft-matter and biological systems, task completion relies on the cumulative arrival of multiple searchers rather than the speed of a single pioneer. The completion kinetics are therefore set not only by the first arrival, but by the full ordered sequence of first-passage times. Here, we determine how stochastic resetting optimizes these ordered arrivals for all arrival ranks. We construct an exact finite-$N$ reference for non-interacting Brownian searchers and obtain the mean ordered first-passage time $\langle T_{(k)} \rangle$ and its optimal resetting rate $r_k^*$. For searchers with identical initial conditions, $r_k^*$ increases monotonically with arrival rank and, with increasing population size, approaches the known large-$N$ quantile limit where a finite optimum appears only above a critical rank fraction $φ_c \simeq 0.412$. Spatial heterogeneity qualitatively reorganizes this sequence, shifting its maximum from late to early ranks even without particle interactions. We then compare this baseline with Brownian colloid experiments, interacting active Brownian particles, and a collective autochemotactic search with persistent environmental memory. Across these systems, sensitivity to resetting increases strongly with arrival rank, while deviations from appropriate non-interacting references reveal the influence of direct interactions, finite return overhead, and environmental memory. Our results show that optimal resetting in multiparticle search is governed by the required completion rank and must be evaluated relative to protocol- and geometry-matched baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机重置如何优化多搜索者的有序首达时间序列，给出非相互作用布朗粒子的精确有限N参考，并比较实验与相互作用系统。
AI.motivation: 许多软物质与生物系统的任务完成依赖多个搜索者的累积到达，而非单个先驱者的速度，因此完成动力学由完整的有序首达时间序列决定，需要研究重置如何优化所有到达秩。
AI.method: 构建非相互作用布朗搜索者的精确有限N参考，求解平均有序首达时间⟨T_(k)⟩及最优重置率r_k*；并对比布朗胶体实验、相互作用活性布朗粒子及具持久环境记忆的集体自趋化搜索。
AI.result: 相同初始条件下，r_k*随到达秩单调增加，并随种群增大趋近大N分位极限，仅在临界秩分数φ_c≈0.412以上出现有限最优；空间异质性使最优秩从后期转到早期。各系统中重置敏感性随到达秩显著增强，偏离非相互作用参考揭示相互作用、有限返回开销和环境记忆的影响。
AI.conclusion: 多粒子搜索中的最优重置由所需完成秩决定，必须相对协议与几何匹配的基线进行评估。

title: A low-symmetry ground state of dense two-dimensional hydrogen
summary: Hydrogen under pressure is an extremely complex system featuring molecular dissociation, metallization, and anomalous melting. While bulk hydrogen has been studied for nearly a century, its two-dimensional counterpart remains unexplored. Using first-principles structural searches and relaxations in supercells containing up to 512 atoms, we identify ground-state structures of dense two-dimensional hydrogen showing no evidence of long-range crystalline order over the simulated length scales. Within density functional theory, these structures have lower enthalpy than all crystalline candidates considered over an intermediate pressure interval between molecular and atomic crystals. This preference already emerges with classical nuclei and persists as the supercell size increases, while the dominant structure-factor peaks grow substantially more slowly than in the crystalline reference phases. Although crystals with very large primitive cells cannot be rigorously excluded, these findings support the possibility of a disordered ground state and identify dense two-dimensional hydrogen as a promising setting for investigating competition between crystallization and structural disorder.

AI.tldr: 本文利用第一性原理结构搜索，发现致密二维氢在中等压力区间存在可能无序基态，其焓低于所有晶体候选结构。
AI.motivation: 三维块体氢已被研究近百年，但二维氢尚未被探索；致密氢涉及解离、金属化与异常熔化等复杂现象，本文关注二维体系中结晶与无序的竞争。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理结构搜索与弛豫，在最多含512个原子的超胞中进行模拟，并采用经典原子核与密度泛函理论计算比较焓及结构因子行为。
AI.result: 无序结构在分子晶体与原子晶体之间的中等压力区间焓低于所有已考虑晶体候选；该优势在经典核及更大超胞下依然存在，且主导结构因子峰的增长远慢于晶体参考相。
AI.conclusion: 虽不能严格排除超大原胞晶体，但结果支持致密二维氢可能存在无序基态，是研究结晶与结构无序竞争的有前景体系。

title: A Majorana Formulation of Time-Dependent Two-Particle Reduced-Density-Matrix Dynamics
summary: We introduce a time-dependent two-particle (TP) reduced-density-matrix algorithm for systems of interacting Majorana fermions. We close the BBGKY hierarchy at the two-particle level by reconstructing the three-particle reduced density matrix from lower-order correlations. To stabilize the evolution, we impose a positivity projection on the two-particle density matrix while preserving chosen conserved quantities such as the energy. We benchmark the approach on quenches in the one-dimensional Hubbard model and on flux dynamics in the Kitaev honeycomb model. For the Hubbard quench, TP captures strong-coupling dynamics missed by Hartree--Fock (HF). For the Kitaev quenches, TP accurately reproduces the early-time flux dynamics in several regimes and provides a substantial improvement over HF when two-particle correlations are important. We further show that gauge coherence is essential for flux dynamics. The projection procedure however introduces an effective irreversibility, which affects the long-time dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种含时两粒子约化密度矩阵(TP)算法,用于相互作用Majorana费米子系统,通过从低阶关联重建三粒子密度矩阵闭合BBGKY层级,并施加正定性投影以稳定演化,在Hubbard模型和Kitaev蜂窝模型上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: Hartree--Fock等低阶方法无法准确描述强关联系统中的两粒子关联动力学,需要一种能捕捉这些效应同时保持数值稳定的方法。
AI.method: 在两粒子层面闭合BBGKY层级,从低阶关联重建三粒子约化密度矩阵;为稳定演化,对两粒子密度矩阵施加正定性投影,同时保持能量等守恒量。
AI.result: 在1D Hubbard模型淬火中,TP捕捉到了HF遗漏的强耦合动力学;在Kitaev蜂窝模型磁通动力学中,TP准确复现早期磁通动力学,且在关联重要时显著优于HF;并证明规范相干性对磁通动力学至关重要。
AI.conclusion: TP算法能有效描述两粒子关联主导的动力学,但正定性投影引入的有效不可逆性会影响长时间动力学,是未来需改进之处。

title: Detection of signals in presence of noise through Josephson junction switching currents
summary: Josephson junctions can be employed to reveal a sinusoidal signal in presence of Gaussian noise. To mimic realistic setups, the detection is performed linearly ramping the bias current until a switch to the finite voltage occurs; the analysis of the resulting switching currents can be exploited to decide about the presence of the harmonic drive. The signal is applied in two conditions: with an unknown initial phase (incoherent strategy) and with a known initial phase (coherent strategy). In both conditions, the analysis of the efficiency of the detection, performed through the signal-to-noise ratio, as estimated by the Kumar-Carrol index, shows that the dependence upon the Josephson junction ramp rate is beneficial, especially for relatively fast speed. One can conclude that the collection of the switching currents is a robust technique, and thus it is possible to exploit the advantages of a predetermined finite time to collect the data.

AI.tldr: 该文利用约瑟夫森结在电流线性扫描下的开关电流分布,探讨在Gaussian噪声中检测正弦信号(已知或未知初相位)的可行性,发现检测效率随扫描速率加快而提升。
AI.motivation: 为贴近真实实验装置,需在有限时间内在高斯噪声背景下判断是否存在谐波驱动信号,并评估其检测的鲁棒性与效率。
AI.method: 对约瑟夫森结线性扫描偏置电流直至跃迁到有限电压,收集跃迁电流统计量;分两种情形(未知初相位的不相干策略、已知初相位的相干策略)施加信号,并用Kumar-Carroll指数估计信噪比以衡量检测效率。
AI.result: 检测效率依赖约瑟夫森结的扫描速率,且该依赖是有利的,尤其在中较快扫描速度下更为明显;两种相位条件下均如此。
AI.conclusion: 收集开关电流是一种鲁棒的检测技术,可利用预先设定的有限采集时间来发挥其优势。

title: Non-Hermitian Quantum Mechanics I: Instantaneous Self-Energy
summary: Starting from the unitary evolution of a closed quantum system, we rigorously demonstrate that the projection of the global wavefunction onto an arbitrary local subsystem is governed by an exact, time-dependent non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation. Crucially, the derivation does not rely on conventional approximations such as the Born approximation, the Markov approximation, or the wide-band limit. The central quantity is the \textit{instantaneous self-energy}, a time-dependent and generally non-Hermitian operator that encodes environmental backaction and, together with the subsystem Hamiltonian, forms the exact time-local generator of the projected dynamics. By benchmarking the conventional non-Hermitian approximation against this exact framework, we systematically expose its limitations. These results provide a rigorous microscopic foundation for the emergence of effective non-Hermitian dynamics in quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文严格证明封闭量子系统全局波函数在任意局域子系统上的投影遵循精确的含时非厄米薛定谔方程，无需Born、Markov或宽带近似。
AI.motivation: 现有有效非厄米动力学多依赖常规近似，缺乏严格的微观基础，其适用性与局限尚不明确。
AI.method: 从封闭量子系统的幺正演化出发，通过将全局波函数投影到局域子系统，引入瞬时自能（含时非厄米算符），构建精确的时间局域生成元，并与常规非厄米近似进行基准对比。
AI.result: 推导出精确的含时非厄米薛定谔方程，揭示瞬时自能编码环境反作用；系统性地暴露了常规非厄米近似的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 为量子系统中有效非厄米动力学的涌现提供了严格的微观基础。

title: VNS Tokamak for Medical Isotope Production
summary: The Volumetric Neutron Source (VNS) tokamak is a proposed fusion reactor for testing components under fusion neutron irradiation, and has potential use for radioisotope production. The VNS geometry is modeled in the Serpent 2.2.2 and OpenMC 0.15.2 neutronics codes. Coupled neutron-photon simulations compared fluxes, spectra, and selected reaction rates in the blanket and vacuum vessel. Good agreement was found overall, with the largest difference found in (n, 2n) reactions. On an HPC cluster, Serpent 2 was found to have shorter computation time in coupled simulations, while OpenMC was faster in neutron only simulations. Radioisotope production yields were simulated in Serpent 2.2.2 for capsule and Cobalt plate irradiation facilities. Results indicate potential for large volume production of 99Mo, 131I, 225Ac, 177Lu, 192Ir, 64Cu, 67Cu, 161Tb, and 153Sm while 203Pb indicates lower potential. 100Mo and LEU target heating was calculated, suggesting the LEU target mass or the cooling may need adjustment. Optimized 60Co production yielded 1.2 GBq/mg and 100,000 TBq after a 3-year irradiation period. Sensitivity to plant outage for 99Mo, 131I, 177Lu, and 60Co was simulated, suggesting irradiation can be restarted for the same isotope loading and demonstrated long-lived 60Co to be robust to long plant dwell-time.

AI.tldr: 本文使用Serpent 2.2.2与OpenMC 0.15.2对VNS托卡马克进行中子学建模与耦合中子-光子模拟，比较通量、能谱与反应率，并评估多种放射性同位素生产潜力。
AI.motivation: VNS托卡马克拟用于在聚变中子辐照下测试部件，并可能用于放射性同位素生产，需要验证中子学建模可靠性并评估同位素生产可行性。
AI.method: 用Serpent 2.2.2和OpenMC 0.15.2对VNS几何建模，开展耦合中子-光子模拟，比较包层与真空室中的通量、能谱及选定反应率；在HPC集群上比较计算时间；用Serpent 2.2.2模拟胶囊与钴板辐照设施的产额，并计算100Mo与LEU靶加热及60Co优化生产，进行停堆敏感性分析。
AI.result: 两程序总体吻合良好，差异最大在(n,2n)反应；Serpent 2耦合模拟更快，OpenMC纯中子模拟更快。结果显示99Mo、131I、225Ac、177Lu、192Ir、64Cu、67Cu、161Tb、153Sm有大规模生产潜力，203Pb潜力较低；LEU靶质量或冷却需调整。优化60Co生产达1.2 GBq/mg，3年辐照后100,000 TBq。99Mo、131I、177Lu、60Co停堆敏感性显示可重启辐照，长寿命60Co对长停堆时间稳健。
AI.conclusion: VNS中子学模型在两代码间具有良好一致性，并显示其在多种医用同位素大规模生产方面具有潜力，同时需优化靶加热与冷却设计。

title: Attosecond charge migration timescales are dominated by transition dipoles, not correlations
summary: Attosecond charge migration (CM) is an ultrafast process occurring when a molecule is irradiated by ultrashort laser pulses, creating a localized hole. The hole propagates rapidly through the molecule, generating electric currents and transferring charge across the molecular backbone. CM is a key ingredient in solar energy conversion, photosynthesis, and radiation damage. Despite its importance and intensive research, the fundamental physical and chemical mechanisms of CM remain not fully understood. Especially, a deeper insight into the role correlations play in the dynamics, and which chemical attributes determine CM timescales, is needed. Here we study with \textit{ab-initio} time-dependent density functional theory CM in the benchmark molecule, BrC$_4$H. We thoroughly explore CM under different initial conditions at the electronic and structural levels, including with theories of varying degrees of electronic correlations. We uncover a universal behavior where the hole moment (connecting to experimental observables) dominant frequency is roughly independent of all of these characteristics. In contrast, the timescales of the hole density evolution do vary with the chemical conditions and level of correlations. Employing a semi-analytical theory that reconstructs the hole moments in the cationic reference frame, we show that the attosecond timescale of CM is determined by molecular dipoles that filter out specific frequency responses with an analogy to optical selection rules. Our results provide essential insight into CM physics, which should be useful for interpreting attosecond experiments and engineering CM timescales by tailoring transition dipoles.

AI.tldr: 该论文用从头算含时密度泛函理论研究BrC₄H分子中的阿秒电荷迁移，发现空穴矩的主导频率是普适的，而时间尺度受化学环境与关联程度影响，由分子偶极以类光学选择定则方式决定。
AI.motivation: 阿秒电荷迁移在太阳能转换、光合作用和辐射损伤中至关重要，但对其基本物理化学机制、关联的作用以及决定CM时间尺度的化学属性仍缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 以BrC₄H为基准分子，采用从头算含时密度泛函理论，在不同电子与结构初始条件、不同电子关联程度下系统研究CM，并使用半解析理论在阳离子参考系中重构空穴矩。
AI.result: 发现空穴矩主导频率大致独立于初始条件和关联程度，呈普适行为；而空穴密度演化的时间尺度随化学条件与关联水平变化。半解析重构表明阿秒时间尺度由分子偶极决定，其作用类似光学选择定则，滤除特定频率响应。
AI.conclusion: 结果深化了对CM物理的理解，有助于解释阿秒实验，并可通过调控跃迁偶极来设计CM时间尺度。

title: The ferromagnetic diatomic molecules with the mixed spin-1/2 and spin-1
summary: Diatomic molecules consisting of one spin-1/2 ($σ$) and one spin-1 ($S$) atom are put at each site of the Bethe lattice (BL) of the coordination number $q=3, 4$, or 6. Alongside the ferromagnetic (FM) interactions of individual atoms within a molecule, the molecules are permitted to engage in ferromagnetic interactions with their nearest neighbors (NN) through diverse bilinear interaction parameters $J$. The spin-1 sites are also under the influence of crystal field $D$. The phase diagrams on the ($D, T$) planes for a given $q$ are obtained by investigating the thermal variations of magnetizations for the case with zero external magnetic field $(H)$. It is discovered that the phase diagrams rely on $q$ both qualitatively and quantitatively. The crystal field is also included which operates only on the spin-1 sites. Three separate FM phases are observed with ($σ,S$) being $(1/2,1), (1/2,0)$ at the ground state level and a phase region with small magnetization (SM) values at a higher temperature range. In addition to the reentrant behavior in the transition zone from one phase to the other, the model produces first- and second-order phase transitions. Additionally, the impact of $H$ on the magnetization curves is examined, yielding quite intriguing findings.

AI.tldr: 在Bethe晶格上研究由spin-1/2与spin-1原子组成的双原子分子的磁性相图，发现相图依赖配位数q，存在三种铁磁相、重入行为及一/二级相变。
AI.motivation: 探究Bethe晶格上混合自旋双原子分子（spin-1/2与spin-1）体系的磁学性质，尤其是配位数q和晶体场D对相图的影响。
AI.method: 将双原子分子置于配位数q=3、4、6的Bethe晶格格点，考虑分子内及最近邻铁磁相互作用（参数J）以及仅作用于spin-1的晶体场D。在零磁场H下通过磁化强度随温度变化得到(D,T)相图，并考察H对磁化曲线的影响。
AI.result: 相图在定性和定量上均依赖q。基态出现(σ,S)=(1/2,1)与(1/2,0)两个铁磁相，高温区存在小磁化强度(SM)相区。除两相间的重入行为外，模型还呈现一级和二级相变。外磁场H对磁化曲线有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该混合自旋双原子分子模型在Bethe晶格上展现出丰富的相图与相变行为，q、D和H对磁性有重要调控作用。

title: Laser-Ablated Au Electrodes with Preferred Orientation and Flat Interface on Oxides
summary: Gold (Au) thin-film electrodes deposited on oxides by pulsed laser deposition (PLD) exhibit distinctive structural properties compared with thermally evaporated Au films. While thermally evaporated Au forms polycrystalline films with randomly oriented grains, PLD-grown Au films show a strong preferred [111] orientation perpendicular to the substrate surface, likely due to the energetic nature of the laser-ablated Au plume. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy reveals atomically flat interfaces between the PLD-grown Au electrodes and epitaxial oxide thin films, separated by nanometer-scale gaps comparable to interlayer spacings in van der Waals materials. The highly ordered microstructure and flat interfacial morphology result in enhanced adhesion of the Au films to oxide surfaces. These results demonstrate that PLD can produce both high-quality Au electrodes and oxide thin films within a single deposition platform, offering improved interfacial control and potential benefits for a wide range of oxide electronic and functional devices.

AI.tldr: PLD沉积的Au薄膜相比热蒸发Au具有强[111]取向、原子级平整界面和增强的粘附性，可在单一平台同时制备高质量Au电极与氧化物薄膜。
AI.motivation: 热蒸发Au薄膜为随机取向多晶，界面质量与粘附性有限，难以满足氧化物电子与功能器件对界面控制的需求。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积（PLD）在氧化物上沉积Au薄膜，利用高分辨透射电镜表征其结构与界面形貌，并与热蒸发Au对比。
AI.result: PLD生长的Au呈强[111]择优取向；Au与氧化物外延薄膜界面原子级平整，存在纳米级间隙（相当于范德华材料层间距）；粘附性增强。
AI.conclusion: PLD可在单一沉积平台同时制备高质量Au电极和氧化物薄膜，改善界面控制，有望应用于多种氧化物电子与功能器件。

title: Carrier duality from the convergence of Dirac fermions and high-order van Hove singularities
summary: The convergence of highly mobile Dirac fermions and flat-band heavy electrons offers a paradigm for emergent quantum phenomena. However, experimental realization of such intriguing state remains elusive. In this study, we report a dual carrier regime in the kagome metal Co3In2S2, wherein the charge transport is governed by high-mobility electrons while the thermodynamic responses exhibit heavy-electron behavior. This exotic duality arises from the coexistence of topological Dirac fermions and flat-band high-order (4th-order) Van Hove singularities (HOVHSs) at the Fermi surface, as revealed by magnetic-torque quantum oscillation and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. The interaction between Dirac and HOVHS-derived carriers can be captured by a minimal two-pocket model, manifesting as sublinear resistivity above ~100 K and field-induced non-Fermi-liquid behavior at low temperatures. Our study establishes Co3In2S2 as a model platform for exploring many-body physics at the intersection of topology and correlation effects, and provides a foundational framework for designing quantum materials hosting diverse emergent states.

AI.tldr: 报告了kagome金属Co3In2S2中的双载流子区域：高迁移率电子主导输运，重电子主导热力学响应，源于拓扑Dirac费米子与平带高阶范霍夫奇点共存。
AI.motivation: 高迁移率Dirac费米子与平带重电子的融合是涌现量子现象的范式，但实验上实现这种状态仍然困难，本文试图在材料中实现并观测该状态。
AI.method: 通过磁转矩量子振荡和角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)探测Co3In2S2的电子结构；用最小双口袋模型描述Dirac与HOVHS载流子相互作用；测量电阻率和低温非费米液体行为。
AI.result: 在Co3In2S2中观察到双载流子：高迁移率电子主导电荷输运，重电子主导热力学响应；证实费米面处拓扑Dirac费米子与4阶范霍夫奇点(HOVHS)共存；表现出~100K以上次线性电阻率及低温场诱导非费米液体行为。
AI.conclusion: Co3In2S2成为探索拓扑与强关联交叉领域多体物理的模型平台，为设计具有多样涌现态的量子材料提供基础框架。

title: New theoretical model of the dynamic anomalies in HTc superconductors
summary: New theoretical model of the dynamic current-voltage characteristics anomalies in HTc superconductors in slowly varying magnetic field has been proposed. The model is based on an analysis in details of the magnetic flux penetration into HTc superconducting slab in such case. The comparison of model with previous experimental data has been presented. Theoretical analysis resulting from a new solution of diffusion equation is given as well as other one based on phenomenological critical state model.

AI.tldr: 提出高温超导体在缓变磁场下动态电流-电压特性异常的新理论模型，基于磁通穿透分析和扩散方程新解，并与先前实验数据对比验证。
AI.motivation: 高温超导体在缓变磁场下的动态电流-电压特性存在异常现象，需要更完善的理论模型来解释磁通穿透机制。
AI.method: 详细分析缓变磁场下磁通穿透高温超导平板的特性；基于扩散方程的新解进行理论分析，同时与唯象临界态模型对比。
AI.result: 模型与先前实验数据进行了对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的新理论模型可解释高温超导体的动态电流-电压特性异常，且与实验数据相符。

title: Sub-Thermionic Switching in a Negative-Capacitance Bandgap-Change Field-Effect Transistor
comment: 9 pages 4 figures. Also includes Supplementary Material with 5 figures
summary: Overcoming the approximately 60~mV/dec Boltzmann limit of the subthreshold swing remains a central challenge for low-power nanoelectronics. Negative-capacitance field-effect transistors address it by amplifying the channel potential, but their effectiveness is constrained by capacitance matching and by the quantum capacitance of conventional channels. Here we model a negative-capacitance bandgap-change field-effect transistor (NC-BCFET), in which the ferroelectric gate stack instead amplifies the electric field that opens the bandgap of the channel, using experimentally proven materials: bilayer graphene as a channel with an electrically tunable bandgap and Al$_{0.55}$Sc$_{0.45}$N as the negative-capacitance ferroelectric. Our self-consistent framework couples a four-band tight-binding Hamiltonian with GW-corrected screening, a quasistatic Landau--Devonshire ferroelectric response, and ballistic Landauer--Büttiker transport. Negative capacitance amplifies the interlayer potential difference, compressing the switching window 37-fold relative to a dielectric-gated control. At 300~K, the optimized NC-BCFET achieves a subthreshold swing of 15~mV/dec, four times below the Boltzmann limit, improving to 2.5~mV/dec at 100~K. The room-temperature on/off ratio is limited to $\sim 10^{2}$ by the bandgap of bilayer graphene. The concept extends directly to materials with larger field-tunable bandgaps, where deep subthermionic switching and high on/off ratios can be achieved together at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 提出负电容带隙变化场效应晶体管(NC-BCFET)，用铁电栅极放大打开双层石墨烯带隙的电场，300K下亚阈值摆幅达15 mV/dec，为玻尔兹曼极限的1/4。
AI.motivation: 克服约60 mV/dec的玻尔兹曼亚阈值摆幅极限是低功耗纳米电子的核心挑战。负电容FET虽可放大沟道电势，但受电容匹配和传统沟道量子电容限制，效果受限。
AI.method: 建立NC-BCFET模型：铁电栅堆栈放大打开沟道带隙的电场，选用实验验证材料——电可调带隙的双层石墨烯沟道与Al0.55Sc0.45N铁电体。自洽框架耦合四带紧束缚哈密顿量+GW修正屏蔽、准静态Landau-Devonshire铁电响应及弹道Landauer-Büttiker输运。
AI.result: 负电容放大了层间电势差，使开关窗口相对介质栅对照压缩37倍。300K优化后SS=15 mV/dec(低于玻尔兹曼极限4倍)，100K降至2.5 mV/dec；室温开关比受双层石墨烯带隙限制约10^2。
AI.conclusion: 该概念可直接推广到具有更大场可调带隙的材料，从而在室温下同时实现深度亚热电子开关与高开关比。

title: LiNiO2/NiO Phase Prediction Using Artificial Neural Networks
summary: In the realm of material analysis, identifying different material phases is of key importance. Artificial intelligence in the form of neural networks provides a very fast and, once trained, computationally inexpensive method for analysing large amounts of image data, like the sets of diffraction patterns generated during four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4DSTEM) dataset acquisition. In this work, we train multiple network architectures on images of this type to distinguish between the phases of LiNiO2 and NiO, an important and challenging distinction in the lithium-ion battery community, since the formation of NiO limits battery capacity. We test both classical convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and different forms of vision transformers (ViTs). Our networks are trained on synthetic images and tested on experimentally recorded diffraction patterns. Additionally, we also investigate the decision-making of our networks using the GradCAM method. We test our networks on both synthetic as well as experimental diffraction patterns. Our networks exhibit very robust results, especially when dealing with highly varying data, an area where traditional template-matching methods typically struggle.

AI.tldr: 训练多种CNN与ViT网络，在4D-STEM衍射图上区分LiNiO2与NiO相，用合成图训练、实验图测试，并用GradCAM分析决策，结果稳健优于模板匹配。
AI.motivation: 材料分析中相识别至关重要，而4D-STEM采集产生海量衍射图。传统模板匹配在数据高度变化时表现不佳，尤其是区分锂离子电池中LiNiO2与NiO（NiO生成会限制电池容量）这一关键且困难的区分任务。
AI.method: 在4D-STEM衍射图上训练多种网络架构以区分LiNiO2与NiO相：涵盖经典CNN和不同形式的ViT。网络在合成图像上训练，在实验记录的衍射图上测试，并使用GradCAM方法研究网络的决策过程。
AI.result: 网络在合成与实验衍射图上均表现非常稳健，尤其在处理数据高度变化的情况时，而这正是传统模板匹配方法通常难以应对的领域。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络（CNN与ViT）可作为一种快速、训练后计算成本低的4D-STEM相识别方法，在变化剧烈的数据上稳健有效，优于模板匹配，并可通过GradCAM提供决策可解释性。

title: AI-assisted analytical theory in soft matter and multiphysics: new results and lessons from diffusiophoresis and bipolar membranes
summary: We present a framework to advance analytical theory in the area of soft matter and multiphysics using assistance from AI. The framework emphasizes (i) setting "honesty rules", (ii) focusing on a few key papers that are used to formulate a problem of interest, (iii) specifying checks a priori, (iv) using only one task per session and keeping a running log of tasks, checks, corrections, and sessions so that a mistake is not propagated through a project, and (v) ensuring all decisions are approved by humans while AI focuses primarily on execution. The framework is applied to two distinct problems to create new knowledge, including (i) diffusiophoresis of a spherical particle in the presence of an arbitrary number of electrolytes at arbitrary Debye lengths, and (ii) analytical description of I-V curves, including overlimiting current, in bipolar membranes without including the water dissociation kinetics. Both of these problems are advanced analyses and would each typically require several months to a year's worth of effort, but were solved in a matter of a few days. However, the increased efficiency should be cautiously navigated to avoid cognitive offloading and ensure that AI-assisted results are used to extract human-readable insights instead of just reporting a new mathematical formula. The usage of AI is transparently presented. Finally, we also share brief thoughts on how to integrate AI tools in theoretical research during graduate education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个借助AI推进软物质与多物理场分析理论的框架，强调"诚实规则"、聚焦关键文献、预先设定检查项、单任务与日志记录、人类审批决策，并用两个难题验证其高效性。
AI.motivation: 分析理论（尤其是软物质与多物理场领域）通常推导复杂、耗时长，单个问题常需数月甚至一年；作者希望借助AI提升理论推导效率，同时避免错误传播与认知外包。
AI.method: 提出并遵循一个五要点框架：(i) 设定"诚实规则"；(ii) 聚焦用于定义问题的少数关键文献；(iii) 事先指定检查项；(iv) 每次会话只做一项任务，并记录任务、检查、修正与会话日志；(v) 所有决策由人类审批，AI主要执行。AI使用过程透明呈现。
AI.result: 框架应用于两个不同问题并产生新知识：(1) 任意数量电解质、任意德拜长度下球形颗粒的扩散泳；(2) 不引入水解离动力学时双极膜I–V曲线（含极限电流以上区域）的解析描述。两者通常各需数月到一年，但在数天内完成。
AI.conclusion: AI可显著加速理论分析研究，但需谨慎以避免认知外包，应提取人类可读的洞见而非仅报告新公式；并简要讨论了研究生教育中整合AI工具的方式。

title: A Spatio-Temporal Generalisation of Green Kubo
comment: 41 pages (double spaced), 14 Figures, pre-final checks draft
summary: The Green-Kubo (GK) method which is used to obtain the shear viscosity of a model liquid in equilibrium molecular dynamics (MD) often requires long simulation times to obtain acceptable statistics. This work extends the GK approach to include spatial correlations. The total shear stress in the GK expression is split into a grid of its components in contiguous volumes. In doing this, the autocorrelation of the total system stress can be rewritten as the cross-correlation of the subvolume stresses. This provides a novel real-space insight into the liquid structure, something previously only treated in Fourier space by liquid-state theory. A novel travelling wave like structure is exposed that is shown to be well fitted by a leading Gaussian pulse added to a second negative Gaussian for the bounce back. The fitting parameters include the wave position, magnitude and width which show deep insights into the liquid property. The wave moves at the speed of sound over short times before decreasing in speed with the square root of time, while the wave packet spreads out also as the square root of time. The magnitude is decreasing with form $t^{-3/2}$, a result with strong significance in the history of MD simulation. These fitted forms mean the entire spatial temporal response of the liquid can be modelled in closed form by fitting to data, with short term requiring MD and the long time and distances approximated by the Gaussian form. By limiting the correlation to localized interactions the longer range contribution, which essentially only contribute to the noise, can be eliminated. This looks like a promising approach to model viscosity by taking short MD runs and fitting the long time behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文将Green-Kubo(GK)方法扩展到空间关联，通过将总剪切应力分解为子体积应力，用交叉相关替代自相关，揭示了液体中的行波结构，并给出闭式高斯模型，可用短MD模拟加拟合预测长时间黏度行为。
AI.motivation: 传统GK方法计算剪切黏度需极长模拟时间才能获得可接受的统计量，效率低；且液体的空间结构信息以往只在傅里叶空间由液体理论处理，缺乏实空间关联的直观图像。
AI.method: 将GK表达式中的总剪切应力按连续子体积网格分解，把总系统应力的自相关改写为子体积应力的交叉相关，从而在实空间引入空间关联分析；并用高斯脉冲叠加反弹负高斯拟合时空响应。
AI.result: 发现类似行波的结构：短时以声速传播，之后速度按时间的平方根衰减，波包同样以平方根时间展宽，幅度按t^{-3/2}衰减；拟合参数包括波的位置、幅度和宽度，能反映液体性质。
AI.conclusion: 该扩展GK方法可用闭式高斯形式描述液体完整的时空响应，短时用MD、长时与远距用高斯近似，并通过限制相关范围消除只贡献噪声的长程项，有望用短MD运行加拟合来建模黏度。

title: Mobility-lifetime relation links photodegradation in spin-coated and gravure-printed organic solar cells
summary: The degradation mechanisms of organic solar cells (OSCs) have been studied primarily in spin-coated, laboratory-scale devices, whereas scalable processing modifies the device architecture, active-layer morphology, and underlying charge-transport and recombination properties. Whether these changes also alter how solar cells degrade remains unclear. Here, we compare spin-coated and fully roll-to-roll-compatible gravure-printed PM6:Y12 solar cells during $\sim$1000 h of continuous illumination. Despite distinct initial properties and degradation signatures, the loss of power-conversion efficiency systematically follows the mobility-lifetime product $μτ$. Remarkably, ageing of the printed devices increases the recombination lifetime while strongly reducing charge-carrier mobility, showing that a longer lifetime alone does not imply improved device performance. The mobility reduction is accompanied by decreased PM6 lamellar order, whereas the additional open-circuit voltage loss originates predominantly from increased non-radiative recombination. Dark recovery further reveals a metastable contribution specific to the printed architecture. These results identify the mobility-lifetime product as a unifying physical descriptor for photodegradation, linking ageing-induced microscopic changes to macroscopic performance loss across spin-coated and scalable printed OSCs.

AI.tldr: 论文比较旋涂与凹版印刷有机太阳能电池在1000小时光照下的降解，发现效率损失统一遵循迁移率-寿命乘积μτ。
AI.motivation: 现有降解研究多基于旋涂实验室器件，而可规模化印刷工艺会改变器件结构与形貌，其是否改变降解机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对比旋涂与全卷对卷兼容凹版印刷的PM6:Y12太阳能电池，在约1000小时连续光照下测试，分析μτ、复合寿命、迁移率、PM6层状有序度、非辐射复合及暗恢复。
AI.result: 尽管初始性能和降解特征不同，效率损失系统遵循μτ；印刷器件老化使复合寿命增加但迁移率大幅下降，伴随PM6层状有序度降低，开路电压额外损失主要来自非辐射复合增强，暗恢复显示印刷结构特有的亚稳态贡献。
AI.conclusion: 迁移率-寿命乘积µτ是统一的光降解物理描述符，将老化诱导的微观变化与旋涂及可规模化印刷OSC的宏观性能损失联系起来。

title: Slave-Rotor and Auxiliary Chain Analysis of the Mott Transition in a Modified Periodic Anderson Model
summary: The Mott-Hubbard transition is a paradigmatic phenomenon driven by strong electronic correlations. We investigate this transition in a three-orbital modified periodic Anderson model using slave-rotor mean-field theory. A minimal two-site cluster extension is introduced to understand the minimal effects of short-range spatial correlations. In comparison to the single-site solution, short-range spatial correlations reveal a shift of the transition point. Going beyond the slave-rotor analysis, we also evaluate the dynamical self-energy and map it onto the boundary Green's function of a non-interacting semi-infinite auxiliary chain. For the metallic phase, the resulting hopping pattern corresponds to a topologically trivial generalized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain. This construction provides a framework for exploring the possible topological character of the Mott transition in this model.

AI.tldr: 本文用slave-rotor平均场研究三轨道修正周期Anderson模型中的Mott-Hubbard转变，通过最小两格点团簇引入短程空间关联，发现转变点移动；进一步计算动力学自能并映射到半无限辅助链的边界格林函数，金属相对应拓扑平庸的广义SSH链。
AI.motivation: Mott-Hubbard转变是强电子关联的典型现象，作者希望在该三轨道模型中理解短程空间关联对转变点的最小效应，并探索该Mott转变可能具有的拓扑特征。
AI.method: 采用slave-rotor平均场理论；引入最小两格点团簇扩展以纳入短程空间关联；在平均场之外评估动力学自能，并将其映射到非相互作用半无限辅助链的边界格林函数。
AI.result: 与单格点解相比，短程空间关联导致转变点发生移动；金属相得到的跳跃模式对应一个拓扑平庸的广义Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链。
AI.conclusion: 该构造为探索此模型中Mott转变可能的拓扑性质提供了框架。

title: Interface engineering of spin triplet Cooper pairs for spin-valve implementation
summary: Spin singlet Cooper pairs can be converted into equal-spin triplet pairs at a superconductor/heavy-metal interface under suitable conditions. Under current carrying conditions, these triplet correlations can give rise to a non equilibrium spin moment in the heavy metal through the predicted supercurrent spin-Hall effect. Here we demonstrate that this current induced triplet spin moment, in conjunction with the magnetic moment of a ferromagnetic layer, can enable a magnetic spin-valve response in Nb/Pt/Ni/Pt/Nb vertical nano-devices. The magnitude of this spin-valve effect depends on the efficiency of singlet-triplet Cooper pair conversion at the Nb/Pt interface. In order to facilitate efficient triplet generation, we deliberately introduced interfacial roughness to introduce finite Rashba spin-orbit coupling at the Nb/Pt interface and an out-of-plane component of magnetic moment at the Ni interface. In contrast, no discernible spin-valve response was observed in devices with smooth interfaces within measurement resolutions. Since the magnetic moment of the Ni layer and the current-induced triplet spin moment in the Pt layer are independently switchable using a magnetic field and bias current, respectively, the spin valve can be controlled via either parameters. These results demonstrates a novel approach to directly utilizing the spin polarized triplet Copper pairs in superconducting spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 在Nb/Pt/Ni/Pt/Nb垂直纳米器件中，通过界面粗糙度引入Rashba自旋轨道耦合，实现了超导自旋阀效应，该效应依赖自旋单态到三重态库珀对的转换。
AI.motivation: 探索如何直接利用自旋极化三重态库珀对实现超导自旋电子学应用，并验证超电流自旋霍尔效应预测的非平衡自旋矩。
AI.method: 制备Nb/Pt/Ni/Pt/Nb垂直纳米器件，故意引入界面粗糙度以增强Nb/Pt界面的Rashba自旋轨道耦合和Ni界面的面外磁矩分量，从而促进单态-三重态库珀对转换。
AI.result: 界面粗糙器件表现出明显的磁自旋阀响应，且响应大小取决于单态-三重态转换效率；界面光滑器件在测量分辨率内无可观测响应。自旋阀可通过磁场（控制Ni磁矩）或偏置电流（控制Pt中三重态自旋矩）独立调控。
AI.conclusion: 该结果展示了一种直接利用自旋极化三重态库珀对的新型超导自旋电子学方法。

title: Universal Generalized Brillouin Zone Theory I: Review of the Spectral Approach
summary: This series of papers aims to establish a universal generalized Brillouin zone (GBZ) theory for higher-dimensional non-Hermitian systems. As the starting point of this series, we emphasize a fundamental question: while the conventional one-dimensional (1D) GBZ condition, $|β_p| = |β_{p+1}|$, is well known to fail in two dimensions, how does this breakdown actually occur as a system gradually crosses over from 1D to 2D? Investigating this question reveals that the existing 1D GBZ theory itself remains incomplete. In this first paper, we therefore systematically review the 1D spectral approach and clarify where the underlying difficulties lie. Our work identifies the key challenges that motivate the wavefunction approach developed in Paper~II.

AI.tldr: 本文是构建高维非厄米系统通用广义布里渊区（GBZ）理论系列论文的第一篇，系统回顾一维谱方法并指出其不足。
AI.motivation: 现有1D GBZ条件|βp|=|βp+1|在2D失效，但系统从1D过渡到2D时该条件如何失效尚不清楚；探究此问题揭示出现有1D GBZ理论本身并不完备。
AI.method: 系统回顾一维谱方法（spectral approach），澄清其内在困难所在，并识别关键挑战。
AI.result: 指出现有1D GBZ理论的不完备性，明确谱方法的困难，并为后续论文的波函数方法奠定动机基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文作为系列论文的起点，为Paper II中发展的波函数方法（wavefunction approach）提供了问题动机。

title: From Heuristics to Machine Learning: The Performance Ceiling for Single-Ion Magnets and Its Electronic Origin
comment: 41 pages including Supporting Information, 9 figures in the main text
summary: Machine learning (ML) is expected to speed up the discovery of single-ion magnets (SIMs), but does the structural information available before synthesis allow such predictions? For 1215 lanthanide complexes from the SIMDAVIS 1.2.1 database we compared three increasing levels of structural description: tabular features of the coordination site, continuous symmetry measures of the coordination polyhedron, and the complete 3D arrangement of atoms. All three converge to an accuracy near 76%, only slightly above the 71% of the single rule "predict SIM for Dy3+". To explain the failures, we combined multireference ab initio calculations with an inspection of the structures behind the high-confidence errors. The SIMs missed by the geometric models are field-induced relaxers whose ground Kramers doublets are prone to tunnelling, a property invisible to geometric descriptors. Many false positives contain several lanthanide centers or radicals, so their relaxation is collective and outside the single-ion picture. The electronic-structure and connectivity information needed to identify SIMs is therefore not accessible to geometric methods alone. Geometric models remain useful: restricting the screening to compounds with high prediction confidence raises the accuracy to 88% while retaining 48% of the dataset. Building on the analysis of the failures, we propose a strategy that combines simple filters for nuclearity and for radicals with ligand-field descriptors from ab initio calculations.

AI.tldr: 该文评估了仅凭合成前结构信息预测单离子磁体(SIM)的可行性：三种几何描述方法准确率均约76%，仅略高于"Dy³⁺即为SIM"这一单规则(71%)，失败源于几何描述无法捕捉的隧穿和集体弛豫效应。
AI.motivation: 机器学习被寄予加速单离子磁体(SIM)发现的期望，但核心疑问是：合成前可获得的结构信息是否足以进行此类预测？作者希望检验几何结构描述对SIM预测的真实能力及其局限。
AI.method: 基于SIMDAVIS 1.2.1数据库中1215个镧系配合物，比较三种递进的结构描述层次：配位点的表格特征、配位多面体的连续对称性度量、以及完整的三维原子排布。并结合多参考态从头算计算与对高置信度错误样本的结构检查来解释预测失败原因。
AI.result: 三种方法的准确率均收敛于约76%，仅略高于单一规则"对Dy³⁺预测为SIM"的71%。几何模型漏检的SIM为场诱导弛豫体，其基态Kramers双态易发生隧穿，该性质对几何描述不可见；许多假阳性含多个镧系中心或自由基，其弛豫是集体性的，超出单离子图像。将筛选限制于高置信度化合物可将准确率提升至88%，同时保留48%的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 识别SIM所需的电子结构与连接性信息无法仅由几何方法获取。几何模型仍有价值（高置信度筛选可提升准确率），作者据此提出结合核数、自由基简单过滤器与从头算配体场描述符的策略。

title: Exact Nonperturbative Equilibrium Mode Statistics in Nonlinear Wave and Lattice Systems
summary: We derive exact finite-size nonperturbative representations of equilibrium modal occupations and related statistics for three representative nonlinear systems: the Majda-McLaughlin-Tabak dispersive-wave model, the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou beta anharmonic chain, and the discrete nonlinear Schrodinger lattice field. Independent simulations confirm the predictions from weak to strong nonlinearity. For DNLS, the theory remains accurate across the weak-coupling quasicondensation crossover, where large low-mode occupations and long-range coherence amplify interaction effects even when the bare nonlinear coefficient is small. The finite-ring DNLS occupations are further resolved into a positive sum of Rayleigh-Jeans channels with distinct correlation lengths, explaining when a single Rayleigh-Jeans law applies and why it fails near quasicondensation. In MMT and DNLS, the exact occupations also determine the mean modal frequencies even when the dynamical spectra broaden or split. The nonperturbative results allow a direct assessment of two representative perturbative approaches. Treating the mean interaction appropriately yields accurate low-order approximations, including at strong nonlinearity. At higher orders, however, the corrections cease to decrease and successive approximations oscillate with increasing amplitude; both finite-order approaches also fail near weak-coupling quasicondensation. Thus neither low-order agreement nor a small bare coupling guarantees a reliable perturbative description. The results establish nonperturbative equilibrium theory for widely used nonlinear wave and lattice models and provide a quantitative basis for modal distributions of energy, particles, and optical power in nonlinear optics, dispersive waves, anharmonic lattices, and cold-atom systems.

AI.tldr: 该文对MMT、FPUT-β链和DNLS三类非线性系统给出相空间模式占据及相关统计量的精确有限尺寸非微扰表达式，仿真验证其从弱到强非线性均成立，并揭示微扰方法失效的条件。
AI.motivation: 非线性波与晶格模型的平衡态模式统计长期依赖微扰或唯象描述，缺乏精确的非微扰理论，尤其难以刻画弱耦合准凝聚等强相互作用效应区。
AI.method: 推导MMT色散波模型、FPUT-β非谐链和离散非线性薛定谔晶格的有限尺寸非微扰平衡模式占据及其相关统计量表示；对DNLS将占据分解为具不同关联长度的Rayleigh-Jeans通道之和，并与独立数值模拟对比。
AI.result: 理论预测在弱至强非线性下均被仿真证实；DNLS结果在弱耦合准凝聚交叉区仍准确；精确占据还给出平均模式频率，即使动力学谱展宽或分裂；低阶微扰在合适处理平均相互作用时仍准确（含强非线性），但高阶修正不收敛且振荡增幅，两种有限阶方法在准凝聚附近均失效。
AI.conclusion: 建立了广泛使用的非线性波与晶格模型的非微扰平衡理论，解释了单一Rayleigh-Jeans律适用与失效的原因，并表明低阶符合或小裸耦合都不能保证微扰描述可靠，为非线性光学、色散波、非谐晶格与冷原子系统中的能量、粒子与光功率模式分布提供定量基础。

title: Revealing epitaxial relationships at Ga$_2$O$_3$ interfaces with p-type oxides
summary: p-type oxide contact layers such as Cr$_2$O$_3$ and NiO are attracting increasing interest in pn-heterojunctions with n-type monoclinic $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ for high-power electronic devices and other extreme environment applications. However, scientific understanding of their epitaxial relationships remains incomplete. In this work we investigate the epitaxial relation of Cr$_2$O$_3$ and NiO layers to (001) and ($\bar{2}$01) out-of-plane oriented Ga$_2$O$_3$ substrates. Surprisingly, we find that, for the most commercially relevant (001)-orientation of the Ga$_2$O$_3$ substrate, the epitaxial relationships are Cr$_2$O$_3$ (0001) and NiO (111) $\parallel$ Ga$_2$O$_3$ (101), both at the non-intuitive $χ$ = 22.5 $^\circ$ angle with respect to the substrate normal. We explain this unusual discovery by the interfacial atomistic bonding dominated by oxygen sublattice equivalence of these Cr$_2$O$_3$ and NiO polar surface orientations to the tilted Ga$_2$O$_3$ (101), rather than Ga$_2$O$_3$ (001) substrate surface planes. Furthermore, we assign the in-plane orientation for Cr$_2$O$_3$ on ($\bar{2}$01)-oriented Ga$_2$O$_3$ as: Cr$_2$O$_3$ $[12\bar{3}0]$ $\parallel$ Ga$_2$O$_3$ $[010]$ with two in-plane rotational domains. Interface modeling confirms the in-plane orientation for Cr$_2$O$_3$/$(\bar{2}01)$ Ga$_2$O$_3$ and shows that strained O-terminated Ga$_2$O$_3$ $(\bar{2}01)$ surfaces have the lowest interfacial energy with Cr$_2$O$_3$ (0001). Beyond establishing the specific epitaxial relationships for Cr$_2$O$_3$ and NiO on Ga$_2$O$_3$, this work provides a systematic methodology for the unambiguous structural characterization of heterointerfaces involving materials with markedly different crystal symmetries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Cr₂O₃和NiO与β-Ga₂O₃的外延关系，发现(001)取向上的取向关系异常地发生在χ=22.5°处，并给出原子级解释。
AI.motivation: p型氧化物（Cr₂O₃、NiO）与n型β-Ga₂O₃构成pn异质结，在高功率器件和极端环境应用中前景广阔，但其外延关系尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 对生长在(001)和(-201)取向Ga₂O₃衬底上的Cr₂O₃、NiO层进行外延关系表征，结合界面原子键合分析与界面建模（含应变O终止表面能量计算）。
AI.result: (001)衬底上Cr₂O₃(0001)、NiO(111)∥Ga₂O₃(101)，与衬底法线成非直观的χ=22.5°；此现象由氧亚晶格等价性主导。Cr₂O₃在(-201)Ga₂O₃上为[12-30]∥[010]并含两个面内旋转畴，O终止(-201)表面与Cr₂O₃(0001)界面能最低。
AI.conclusion: 明确了Cr₂O₃和NiO在Ga₂O₃上的具体外延关系，并提供了一套针对晶体对称性差异大的异质界面进行明确结构表征的系统方法学。

title: Spin-Orbit Induced Confinement of Correlated Bound States in the Continuum
summary: Repulsively bound doublons are two-particle composites formed by strong interactions and are usually separated from the scattering continuum. Introducing spin-orbit coupling fundamentally alters the underlying band structure, providing a powerful tuning knob to shift these isolated pairs toward this continuum. However, because entering such a regime typically dictates immediate dissociation, whether this coupling can drive these pairs inside while preserving their bound nature constitutes a fundamental unresolved challenge. Here we show that spin-orbit coupling in the one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model can drive doublons into the two-particle scattering continuum. Most of these states hybridize with extended channels and decay, whereas a subset remains decoupled and spatially bound, forming many-body bound states in the continuum (BICs). We map the interacting two-particle problem onto a two-dimensional lattice of coupled acoustic cavities, and experimentally observe both the radiating doublon continuum and the confined BIC states. These results demonstrate that spin-orbit coupling can turn selected doublons into interaction-induced BICs, deepening the understanding of continuum physics for interaction-bound pairs.

AI.tldr: 在一维Fermi-Hubbard模型中，自旋轨道耦合可将束缚的双占位子（doublon）驱动进入双粒子散射连续谱；多数态与扩展通道杂交并衰变，但子集保持解耦与空间束缚，形成连续谱中的多体束缚态（BIC），并在耦合声学腔阵列中实验观测到辐射连续谱与受限BIC态。
AI.motivation: 排斥束缚的双占位子通常与散射连续谱分离。自旋轨道耦合改变能带结构，可将这些孤立对移向连续谱，但进入该区域通常导致立即解离，因此能否在进入连续谱的同时保持束缚性质是未解决的基本挑战。
AI.method: 将一维Fermi-Hubbard模型中的相互作用双粒子问题映射到二维耦合声学腔晶格，并通过实验观测辐射的双占位子连续谱与受限的BIC态。
AI.result: 自旋轨道耦合可将双占位子驱动进入双粒子散射连续谱；多数态与扩展通道杂交并衰变，而部分态保持解耦和空间束缚，形成相互作用诱导的BIC，并在实验中同时观测到辐射连续谱与受限BIC态。
AI.conclusion: 自旋轨道耦合可将特定双占位子转化为相互作用诱导的连续谱束缚态，深化了对相互作用束缚对连续谱物理的理解。

title: Generalized conditions for odd-frequency pairing in superconducting systems
summary: Odd-frequency superconducting pairing has been predicted to arise in many systems and is known to lead to phenomena such as paramagnetic Meissner response and long-range superconducting proximity effect. Here, we provide generalized necessary and sufficient conditions for odd-frequency pairing appearing in any superconducting system, from bulk superconductors to superconducting hybrid structures. This generalizes an earlier first-order expression in multiband bulk superconductors to all superconducting systems and to all orders, in both order parameter and frequency. We then apply the derived conditions to several systems, including superconducting-ferromagnet and superconducting Josephson junctions, as well as a transition metal dichalcogenide monolayer proximitized by a conventional superconductor, where the generalized conditions are used to understand the properties of the superconducting state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出奇频超导配对的广义充要条件，适用于从体超导体到超导混合结构的所有系统，并将此前多带体超导体的首阶表达式推广到任意阶（同时针对序参量和频率）。随后将该条件应用于超导-铁磁体、超导约瑟夫森结及过渡金属硫族化物单层近邻化系统。
AI.motivation: 奇频超导配对已在众多系统中被预测出现，并被认为会导致顺磁迈斯纳响应和长程超导近邻效应等现象。然而，此前对奇频配对的判定仅有多带体超导体中的首阶表达式，缺乏适用于所有超导系统、所有阶的普适判据。
AI.method: 作者推导了奇频配对出现的广义充要条件，将其从多带体超导体的首阶表达推广至所有超导系统以及序参量和频率的任意阶。随后将该条件应用于超导-铁磁体、超导约瑟夫森结，以及经常规超导体近邻化的过渡金属硫族化物单层等系统。
AI.result: 所得广义条件成功刻画了上述多种系统中超导态的奇频配对特性，可用于理解这些系统的超导态性质。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为任意超导系统中奇频配对的出现提供了普适的充要判据，并展示了其在体材料与混合结构中的广泛适用性。

title: Multiscale Modeling of Ion Transport in Nanopores: Fitting Implicit-Water Radial Diffusion Profiles to Explicit-Water Molecular Dynamics
summary: We develop a multiscale approach for incorporating molecular-scale transport information into computationally efficient models of ion transport through nanopores. A radially varying effective diffusion coefficient profile is fitted to radial conductivity profiles obtained from explicit-water molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The fitting is performed within the NP+LEMC framework, which combines the Nernst--Planck equation with Local Equilibrium Monte Carlo to account for ion correlations beyond mean-field approximation. We apply the approach to NaCl, CaCl$_2$, and their mixtures in a negatively charged silica nanopore. The resulting diffusion coefficient profiles reproduce the radial current distributions of the MD simulations, including the strong suppression of ionic mobility near the pore wall that cannot be captured by a spatially constant diffusion coefficient inside the pore. NaCl and CaCl$_2$ exhibit qualitatively different transport behavior: the former is cation selective due to enhanced near-wall Na$^+$ conduction, whereas the latter shows weak anion selectivity because strongly bound Ca$^{2+}$ ions have strongly suppressed mobility near the surface. For NaCl--CaCl$_2$ mixtures, preferential Ca$^{2+}$ binding leads to nonlinear changes in ionic conductance. The approach establishes a bridge between experimentally relevant device behavior and computationally efficient reduced models, with explicit-water MD providing the molecular-scale information that can be incorporated into the effective transport coefficients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多尺度方法，将分子尺度传输信息（来自显式水MD）拟合成径向有效扩散系数，嵌入NP+LEMC框架，用于高效模拟纳米孔中离子传输。
AI.motivation: 纳米孔离子传输的高效模型通常使用空间恒定扩散系数，无法捕捉近孔壁处离子迁移率被强烈抑制的现象，需要一种能融合分子尺度信息的方法。
AI.method: 在NP+LEMC框架（Nernst-Planck方程结合Local Equilibrium Monte Carlo，考虑超越平均场的离子关联）中，将径向导率曲线（由显式水MD获得）拟合为径向变化的有效扩散系数剖面。
AI.result: 得到的扩散系数剖面再现了MD的径向电流分布，包括恒定扩散系数无法捕捉的近壁迁移率抑制。NaCl呈阳离子选择性（近壁Na+传导增强），CaCl2呈弱阴离子选择性（强结合的Ca2+近表面迁移率被强烈抑制）；NaCl-CaCl2混合物中Ca2+优先结合导致电导非线性变化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在实验相关器件行为与计算高效的简化模型之间建立了桥梁，显式水MD提供的分子尺度信息可被纳入有效传输系数。

title: Interplay of spin-orbit coupling and magnetic chirality: Multidirectional spin polarization in a helical antiferromagnet
summary: We investigate spin-dependent transport in a non-collinear helical antiferromagnet in the presence of spin-orbit coupling within a tight-binding framework. Using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, we analyze the generation of spin polarization arising from the combined effects of the helical magnetic texture and spin-orbit interaction. We find that finite spin polarization can be generated simultaneously along the $\hat{x}$, $\hat{y}$, and $\hat{z}$-directions, in contrast to the predominantly single-axis spin polarization commonly observed in conventional spin-filtering systems. The multidirectional spin polarization originates from the symmetry breaking introduced by the non-collinear magnetic order. We further show that the spin polarization is modified significantly in the presence of spin-orbit coupling and it has strong dependence on the parameters associated with the helical system. In particular, long-range hopping significantly enhances the spin-filtering effect, leading to large spin polarization components along all three spatial directions.

AI.tldr: 研究非共线螺旋反铁磁体中自旋轨道耦合下的自旋输运，发现可同时产生沿x、y、z三方向的自旋极化。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋过滤系统通常只产生单一方向的自旋极化，本文探索 helical 磁结构与自旋轨道耦合结合能否产生多方向自旋极化。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚框架，结合Landauer-Büttiker形式分析helical反铁磁体中的自旋输运。
AI.result: 发现自旋极化可同时沿x、y、z三方向产生，源于非共线磁序的对称性破缺；自旋轨道耦合显著改变极化，长程跃迁增强自旋过滤效应，三方向极化分量均增大。
AI.conclusion: 非共线螺旋磁序与自旋轨道耦合协同可实现多方向自旋极化，且可通过系统参数调控。

title: Composition-Dependent Self-Diffusion Coefficients in Liquid Mixtures from Hybrid Machine Learning
summary: Self-diffusion coefficients are key descriptors of molecular mobility, yet experimental data remain scarce, highlighting the need for reliable prediction methods. In previous work, we introduced the hybrid Enhanced Stokes-Einstein (ESE) model, which advanced the state of the art in the physically consistent prediction of self-diffusion coefficients of solutes at infinite dilution in pure solvents by integrating the Stokes-Einstein equation with machine learning (ML). Here, we extend this approach to concentration-dependent self-diffusion coefficients and multicomponent solvents with HADES. This hybrid architecture leverages a deep-set neural network to connect pure-component and mixture prediction within a single framework. HADES predicts self-diffusion coefficients in liquid mixtures with any number of components at any composition and temperature. The only required inputs are SMILES-encoded molecular structures of the components and the pure-component viscosities, making the method broadly applicable. Trained and evaluated on a comprehensive dataset of 2526 data points for 600 systems, HADES significantly outperforms benchmark prediction methods. The trained model and its source code are fully disclosed, and the application is available via an interactive website https://ml-prop.mv.rptu.de/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HADES模型，将Enhanced Stokes-Einstein (ESE)方法扩展到浓度依赖的多元溶剂自扩散系数预测，利用深度集合神经网络统一纯组分与混合物预测。
AI.motivation: 自扩散系数是分子迁移性的关键描述符，但实验数据稀缺，亟需可靠的预测方法；此前ESE模型仅适用于纯溶剂中无限稀释溶质，无法处理浓度依赖和多元溶剂情形。
AI.method: HADES为混合架构，采用深度集合(deep-set)神经网络，将纯组分与混合物预测纳入单一框架，融合Stokes-Einstein方程与机器学习。输入仅需组分的SMILES分子结构与纯组分粘度，可在任意组分数量、组成和温度下预测液体混合物中的自扩散系数。
AI.result: 在包含600个体系、2526个数据点的综合数据集上训练与评估，HADES显著优于基准预测方法。
AI.conclusion: HADES实现了广泛适用的浓度依赖多元混合物自扩散系数预测，模型与源代码完全公开，并提供交互式网站 https://ml-prop.mv.rptu.de/。

title: Derivation of the Thiele equation for magnetic skyrmions using the Mori-Zwanzig formalism
summary: We use the Mori-Zwanzig formalism to derive an exact generalized Langevin equation governing the dynamics of magnetic skyrmions. Using standard approximations, this generalized Langevin equation is found to reduce to the usual Thiele equation. Our approach provides a general route for obtaining extensions of the Thiele equation applicable to magnetic textures and degrees of freedom not covered by the standard derivation route. It also provides some insights into the microscopic justification of the standard Thiele equation, specifically concerning contributions of fast modes to the form of the drift and diffusion terms in the Fokker-Planck equation for skyrmions.

AI.tldr: 利用Mori-Zwanzig形式推导磁性斯格明子的精确广义朗之万方程，在标准近似下退化为Thiele方程，为扩展Thiele方程提供通用途径。
AI.motivation: 标准Thiele方程缺乏严格的微观推导依据，尤其是快模对漂移和扩散项贡献的微观机理尚不清晰。
AI.method: 采用Mori-Zwanzig投影形式体系，推导支配斯格明子动力学的精确广义朗之万方程。
AI.result: 在标准近似下，广义朗之万方程退化为通常的Thiele方程。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为推导适用于标准途径无法覆盖的磁结构及自由度的Thiele方程扩展提供了通用途径，并为标准Thiele方程的微观合理性提供了洞见。

title: Experiments and Modeling of Defect Dynamics and BTI Behavior in Doped InO TFTs during $400^\circ$C Post-Processing Forming Gas Annealing
summary: We investigate the impact of a monolithic three-dimensional (M3D) integration process-critical $400^\circ$C post-processing forming gas anneal (FGA) on the electrical performance, reliability, and defect evolution of oxide-channel thin-film transistors (TFTs), combining systematic experiments with density-functional-theory (DFT)-based liquid-quench molecular-dynamics (MD) simulations. Indium tungsten oxide (IWO) TFTs are employed as a model system and encapsulated with a thin 3 nm Al$_2$O$_3$ / 3 nm HfO$_2$ hybrid layer that effectively suppresses external hydrogen ingress. We reveal a non-monotonic evolution of device behavior during FGA, governed by initial densification followed by partial crystallization. Short-duration FGA (10 min) induces channel densification and the formation of shallow, delocalized defect states, leading to pronounced positive bias temperature instability (PBTI) degradation and the emergence of a characteristic transfer-curve "kink." With prolonged annealing (>40 min), partial crystallization of the oxide channel occurs, stabilizing hydrogen in deep, localized defect states, suppressing hydrogen mobility, and restoring device reliability. As a result, the PBTI shift is reduced to 10.4 mV after 2000 seconds of stress, accompanied by complete elimination of the transfer-curve kink. These findings provide a mechanistic understanding of hydrogen-defect interactions during high-temperature post-processing FGA and demonstrate that appropriate hydrogen-blocking encapsulation enables oxide-channel TFT integration without compromising electrical performance or reliability.

AI.tldr: 研究M3D集成中400°C FGA对IWO氧化物沟道TFT的影响，发现器件行为随退火时间呈非单调变化：短时退火致PBTI退化和转移曲线"kink"，长时退火因部分晶化稳定氢于深能级缺陷态，恢复可靠性。
AI.motivation: M3D集成需经400°C后处理FGA，氢气与氧化物沟道缺陷相互作用机制不明，影响器件性能与可靠性，需厘清其机理。
AI.method: 以IWO TFT为模型，用3 nm Al₂O₃/3 nm HfO₂混合层封装阻挡外部氢进入；结合系统实验与基于DFT的液态淬火MD模拟，研究FGA下电性能、可靠性与缺陷演化。
AI.result: 短时FGA(10 min)致沟道致密化、形成浅而离域的缺陷态，加剧PBTI退化并出现转移曲线kink；长时间退火(>40 min)使沟道部分晶化，氢稳定于深局域缺陷态、抑制氢迁移，2000 s应力后PBTI漂移降至10.4 mV，kink完全消失。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了高温FGA中氢-缺陷相互作用机理，表明合适的阻氢封装可实现氧化物沟道TFT集成而不损害电性能与可靠性。

title: Charge-4e Superconducting Ground State without Pair Condensation: Exact Quartet Dynamics, Rigorous Order, and a Microscopic Route
summary: A direct charge-\(4e\) superconductor exhibits coherent four-electron order while every charge-\(2e\) pairing channel remains uncondensed. We establish three complementary results. First, building on the \(η\)-clustering states and bipartite parent of Yoshida and Katsura, we formulate and exactly solve a minimal two-term parent on any connected graph. Its fixed-number ground states have quartet off-diagonal long-range order (ODLRO) without charge-\(2e\) ODLRO, while an exact mapping to classical hard-core exclusion dynamics yields the full fixed-sector gap and a branch of quartet-density modes. Nonzero quartet stiffness and vanishing inverse quartet compressibility identify this \(z=2\) parent as a phase-separation boundary. Second, for a finite-range fermionic family with explicit quartet transfer and sufficiently large onsite penalty, we rigorously prove quartet ODLRO without charge-\(2e\) ODLRO at half quartet filling, both at the hypercubic XY point for \(d\geq2\) and throughout a finite XXZ interval on the square lattice. Third, we derive a strong-coupling realization using only electron hopping and two-body interactions. With local gap \(U_0\), pair hopping \(K\) generates quartet motion at order \(K^2/U_0\), whereas electron hopping \(t\) first contributes at order \(t^4/U_0^3\); charge-\(2e\) excitations remain gapped at \(O(U_0)\). On bipartite lattices, positive inverse quartet compressibility opens an asymptotically controlled homogeneous \(z=1\) regime with short-ranged pair correlations, while negative curvature drives phase separation.

AI.tldr: 该文构建并严格求解了直接电荷-4e超导的极小母体模型，证明四电子（quartet）序可在无任何电荷-2e凝聚的情况下相干存在，并给出强耦合实现方案。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：探索一种直接电荷-4e超导体——四电子相干序存在而所有电荷-2e配对通道均未凝聚，并为其建立可严格处理的模型基础。
AI.method: 方法：(1) 基于η-团簇态与二分母体，构建并精确求解任意连通图上的两项极小母体，映射到经典硬核排除动力学求固定粒子数扇区能隙与四重态密度模；(2) 对含显式四重态转移的有限程费米子族，在强在位惩罚下严格证明半四重态填充时的quartet ODLRO（无电荷-2e ODLRO）；(3) 仅用电子跃迁与两体相互作用给出强耦合实现，分析K²/U₀与t⁴/U₀³的序竞争。
AI.result: 结果：极小母体具有quartet ODLRO而无电荷-2e ODLRO，非零四重态刚度与消失的逆四重态压缩率标定其为z=2相分离边界；有限程费米子族在超立方XY点(d≥2)及方格子XXZ区间严格成立；强耦合中配对跃迁K以K²/U₀生成四重态运动，电子跃迁t首次贡献为t⁴/U₀³，电荷-2e激发在O(U₀)保持能隙。
AI.conclusion: 结论：二分格子上正逆四重态压缩率开启渐近可控的均匀z=1区（配对关联短程），负曲率驱动相分离；该框架为直接电荷-4e超导提供了可解模型与强耦合实现途径。

title: Electronic Reconstruction Towards Topological Superconductivity in FeTe
comment: 35 pages and 4 figures. Comments are very much welcome
summary: The recent discovery of intrinsic superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe films has renewed interest in the Te-rich end member of the iron chalcogenides for studies of unconventional and topological superconductivity, yet its intrinsic electronic structure remains unresolved. In this work, we combine molecular beam epitaxy, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), electrical transport measurements, density functional theory, and embedded dynamical mean-field theory to track the electronic reconstruction of 20-unit-cell FeTe films as Te annealing progressively removes excess interstitial Fe and drives the system from an antiferromagnetic metal to a superconductor. We find that this evolution is accompanied by recovered quasiparticle coherence, reduced electronic correlations, a Lifshitz transition, and a topological phase transition, yielding dxy-dominated hole and electron pockets that favor inter-pocket scattering. In addition, a shallow dxz/dyz-derived hole band located about 2 meV below the Fermi level may provide an incipient-band pairing channel, while scattering between the two electron pockets at M may offer additional pairing channels. High-resolution polarization-dependent laser ARPES measurements further reveal a topological surface state whose circular dichroism is consistent with the expected orbital-angular-momentum texture of stoichiometric FeTe. These results establish the intrinsic low-energy electronic structure of superconducting FeTe and identify the electronic states most relevant to superconductivity. The coexistence of intrinsic superconductivity and a topological surface state establishes stoichiometric FeTe as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity and possible Majorana bound states.

AI.tldr: 通过MBE、ARPES、输运、DFT和嵌入式DMFT研究FeTe薄膜随Te退火去除间隙Fe的电子重构，从反铁磁金属到超导体，揭示准粒子相干恢复、关联减弱、Lifshitz与拓扑相变，并发现拓扑表面态，确立FeTe为拓扑超导平台。
AI.motivation: 化学计量比FeTe薄膜中本征超导的发现重新激发对其研究兴趣，但其本征电子结构尚未解决。
AI.method: 结合分子束外延、ARPES、电输运测量、DFT和嵌入式动力学平均场理论，追踪20单胞FeTe薄膜的电子重构；并用高分辨偏振依赖激光ARPES测量。
AI.result: Te退火去除间隙Fe过程中，系统从反铁磁金属演变为超导体，伴随准粒子相干恢复、电子关联减弱、Lifshitz相变和拓扑相变；形成dxy主导的空穴和电子口袋，利于口袋间散射；Fermi面下约2meV的浅dxz/dyz空穴带可能提供初始能带配对通道，M点两电子口袋间散射提供额外配对通道；拓扑表面态的圆二色性与轨道角动量织构一致。
AI.conclusion: 确立了超导FeTe的本征低能电子结构，识别了与超导最相关的电子态；本征超导与拓扑表面态共存使化学计量比FeTe成为探索拓扑超导及可能Majorana束缚态的潜力平台。

title: Experimentally validated process-microstructure-property relations of bainitic steels derived from phase-field simulations
summary: This study examines the impact of processing conditions, such as thermalprocessing, on the resulting microstructure and mechanical properties. Spe-cial emphasis is placed on microstructural features obtained from three-dimensional phase-field simulations, which provide detailed insights into bai-nite morphology, phase distribution and retained austenite content. Thesesimulated microstructures are correlated with changes in yield strength undermultiaxial load, as represented in the yield surface of the material. The re-sults demonstrate that optimized processing routes can refine the microstruc-ture, enhance mechanical properties and significantly alter the yield surfacecharacteristics. These findings provide valuable insights for the design andapplication of bainitic steels, as well as for the development of predictivemodels linking process-structure-property relationships.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合热加工工艺、三维相场模拟的微观组织特征与多轴屈服面，揭示工艺-组织-性能关系，表明优化工艺路线可细化组织、提升力学性能并显著改变屈服面特征。
AI.motivation: 探究热加工等工艺条件如何影响贝氏体钢的微观组织与力学性能，并建立工艺-组织-性能的预测性关联，以指导贝氏体钢的设计与应用。
AI.method: 采用三维相场模拟获取微观组织特征（贝氏体形貌、相分布、残余奥氏体含量），并将其与多轴载荷下屈服强度的变化（以材料屈服面表征）进行关联分析。
AI.result: 优化后的工艺路线可细化微观组织、提升力学性能，并显著改变屈服面特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究为贝氏体钢的设计与应用以及工艺-组织-性能预测模型的开发提供了有价值的见解。

title: Benchmarking higher-ranking multipoles and polarizability tensors for small molecular systems
summary:
Molecular properties govern how molecules interact with one another or external fields. Accurate molecular properties are essential for constructing intermolecular interaction models, and to achieve high accuracy we need to go beyond leading-order (dipolar) terms.
  This work presents CCSD(T) references for 73 small non-spin-polarized molecules for molecular dipole and quadrupole moments, and dipole-dipole and quadrupole-quadrupole polarizabilities. Using these results, we provide a holistic performance analysis of molecular properties computed with HF, MP2, CCSD, and a wide range of density-functional methods. Additionally, we investigate in detail what levels of basis sets are required to simultaneously describe all properties in the data set.
  The best-performing density functionals for all four properties are the asymptotically cor- rected hybrid GGAs B97-3-AC, closely followed by PBE0-AC. Surprisingly, modern meta- GGAs and range-separated functionals perform inconsistently, with large errors in the quadrupo- lar properties. These results have direct implications for methods for intermolecular interac- tions, such as symmetry-adapted perturbation theory based on density functional theory, or for the quality of properties and interactions in machine-learning datasets.
  Finally, for DFT methods, the Jensen aug-pcseg-2 basis set is a computationally efficient alternative to more established basis sets, but for generating correlated references, third-row elements benefit from core polarization, and double augmentation is strictly necessary for quadrupole-quadrupole polarizabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文为73个小分子的偶极/四极矩及偶极-偶极、四极-四极极化率提供CCSD(T)参考值，系统评估HF、MP2、CCSD及多种DFT方法的表现，并研究所需基组水平。B97-3-AC与PBE0-AC整体最优，而现代meta-GGA和range-separated泛函在四极性质上误差较大。
AI.motivation: 准确分子性质是构建分子间相互作用模型的基础；要获得高精度必须超越领头阶（偶极）项，因此需要系统评估各类方法对偶极、四极矩及相应极化率的计算能力。
AI.method: 对73个非自旋极化小分子，用CCSD(T)计算偶极矩、四极矩、偶极-偶极与四极-四极极化率作为参考值；用HF、MP2、CCSD和多种密度泛函方法计算这些性质并进行整体性能分析；同时考察同时描述所有性质所需的基组水平。
AI.result: 四类性质整体表现最好的是渐近校正混合GGA泛函B97-3-AC，PBE0-AC紧随其后；现代meta-GGA和range-separated泛函表现不一致，在四极性质上误差很大。对DFT方法，Jensen aug-pcseg-2基组是计算高效的选择；但相关参考值需考虑第三周期元素的核心极化，且四极-四极极化率必须使用双增广基组。
AI.conclusion: 该结果对基于DFT的对称性适配微扰理论等分子间相互作用方法、以及机器学习数据集中的性质与相互作用质量具有直接影响；选泛函与基组时需特别关注四极相关性质。

title: Ageing in the exact correlations of the voter model on a fractal
summary: The exact behaviour of the enveloppes of the single-time and two-time correlators is found for the voter model on a fractal substrate, with nearest-neighbour interactions. Herein the geometry of the fractal substrate is described by its non-integer geometric fractal dimension $d_f$, and its topology and diffusive transport by the distinct spectral dimension $d_s$. On the level of the equations of motion of the correlators this can be modelled by considering a space-dependent diffusion constant ${\cal D}(r)\sim r^{-θ}$ which implies the spectral index $θ$, itself a function of $d_f$ and $d_s$. With a scaling ansatz, the generic phenomenology of ageing is confirmed and the dynamic exponent ${z}=2+θ$ and the autocorrelation exponent $λ=d_f$ are derived. The explicitly found dynamic scaling functions are shown to depend only on the spectral dimension $d_s$. The decay of the enveloppe of the density of active interfaces with time is described by the exponent $α=1-d_s/2$ for $d_s<2$, confirming the results of preexisting numerical simulations.

AI.tldr: 研究了分形基底上近邻作用voter模型的单时与双时关联函数包络行为，得出标度指数并由谱维数确定动力学标度函数。
AI.motivation: 探讨分形基底上voter模型的关联函数包络精确行为，区分几何分形维数df、谱维数ds及扩散输运对老化现象的影响。
AI.method: 用空间依赖扩散常数D(r)~r^{-θ}建模，θ为df与ds的函数，采用标度ansatz推导关联函数方程。
AI.result: 确认老化现象，导出动力学指数z=2+θ、自关联指数λ=df；标度函数仅依赖谱维数ds；界面密度包络衰减指数α=1-ds/2 (ds<2)，与已有数值模拟一致。
AI.conclusion: 分形基底上voter模型的老化动力学由谱维数支配，标度函数与边界密度衰减均得到解析确认。

title: Compressive Splitting in Brittle Solids: The Inverse of Wrinkling in Sheets
comment: To appear in Physical Review Letters
summary: Axial splitting is the dominant failure mode of brittle solids under compression, yet its mechanical origin remains unclear. We show that clamped loading platens suppress lateral Poisson expansion, generating boundary-induced tensile stresses at the specimen interior -- the compressive analog of wrinkling in stretched sheets. This mechanism provides a predictive strength law, relating axial splitting to tensile strength, geometry, and confinement pressure. This is validated against diverse materials ranging from rocks to ceramics, establishing axial splitting as a geometry-controlled elastic process rather than a stochastic flaw problem.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示脆性固体压缩下轴向劈裂的力学起源——由刚性加载板约束侧向泊松膨胀引起内部拉应力，并据此提出可预测的强度定律。
AI.motivation: 轴向劈裂是脆性固体压缩下的主导破坏模式，但其力学起源长期不明确（通常被归因于随机缺陷）。
AI.method: 分析夹持加载板对侧向泊松膨胀的抑制，提出边界诱导的内部拉应力机制（类比拉伸薄板起皱），建立关联轴向劈裂与抗拉强度、几何及围压的强度定律。
AI.result: 所提出的强度定律在岩石、陶瓷等多种材料上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 轴向劈裂是几何控制的弹性过程，而非随机缺陷问题。

title: Carrier-mediated spin helices in low-dimensional systems: Josephson-interference features and correlation renormalization
summary: Carrier-induced helical magnetism can arise in interacting one-dimensional systems coupled to localized moments. Here, we investigate the coupled-wire sliding-Luttinger-liquid counterparts with and without valley degrees of freedom, using isolated Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids as reference limits. The carrier spin susceptibility mediates a Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida interaction that selects the helical ordering wave vector, while interchannel correlations lock the relative helix phases and stabilize a collective quasi-two-dimensional texture. Using a variational treatment, we estimate the helix-induced partial gap and analyze the reconstruction of the remaining gapless carrier modes. To probe the spatial texture through transport, we incorporate the helix into an anisotropic superconductor-normal-metal-superconductor Josephson junction motivated by the coupled-channel structure of twisted bilayer WTe$_2$. We exploit flux focusing near the junction interfaces to make an applied in-plane field a controlled probe of the spin helix. Relative to junctions without the helix, the helical exchange field modifies the central-lobe width and relative lobe weights. In the transverse-channel geometry, it also produces field-dependent side-lobe asymmetry and central-peak displacement, which remain negligible in the matched references for the parameters considered. The reconstructed carrier sector also exhibits modified local-density-of-states exponents, spin-relaxation behavior, and competing correlations, with distinct signatures in isolated and coupled-wire systems. Our results connect collective helical order in coupled-wire systems to carrier-sector reconstruction and identify field-tunable Josephson interferometry as a complementary transport probe of the spatial spin texture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究耦合线滑动Luttinger液体中的载流子诱导螺旋磁性，提出用场可调Josephson干涉测量探测空间自旋织构。
AI.motivation: 载流子诱导的螺旋磁性可在相互作用一维系统与局域磁矩耦合时出现，需要探索耦合线滑动Luttinger液体对应体，并寻找通过输运探测空间自旋织构的手段。
AI.method: 以孤立Tomonaga-Luttinger液体为参考极限，研究含与不含谷自由度的耦合线系统；载流子自旋磁化率介导RKKY相互作用选择螺旋序波矢，通道间关联锁定相对螺旋相；用变分处理估计螺旋诱导的部分能隙；将螺旋纳入各向异性SNS Josephson结，利用结界面附近磁通聚焦使面内场成为自旋螺旋的受控探针。
AI.result: 螺旋交换场改变中心瓣宽度和相对瓣权重；在横向通道几何中产生场依赖的边瓣不对称和中心峰位移，而匹配参考中这些效应可忽略；重构后的载流子扇区显示修正的局域态密度指数、自旋弛豫行为和竞争关联，在孤立与耦合线系统中具有不同特征。
AI.conclusion: 结果将耦合线系统中的集体螺旋序与载流子扇区重构联系起来，并表明场可调Josephson干涉测量可作为空间自旋织构的互补输运探针。

title: Scalable Multiple Electron Transport Architectures for Feedback Traceable Current Sources
summary:
We present a scalable electron-counting current cell based on a floating gate architecture operated as a Multiple Electron Transport device (MET). The system enables controlled injection, transport, and precise quantification of discrete charge packets using the sensor non-destructive multiple readout capability. We repurposed the charge-injection technique, jointly with the electron-resolution capability, for a controlled generation of quantized charge packets for an electron-traceable current source.
  Scalable architectures based on parallel and series multi-amplifier configurations are explored. Experimental results confirm noise reduction following the square root of the number of independent measurements and demonstrate stable, programmable output current. This approach provides a compact and scalable platform for electron-counting current sources and precision quantum metrology applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于浮栅架构的可扩展电子计数电流单元，作为多数电子输运（MET）器件，实现离散电荷包的受控注入、输运与精确量化，并用其构建电子可追溯电流源；通过并联/串联多放大器架构验证噪声按独立测量数平方根下降，获得稳定的可编程输出电流。
AI.motivation: 面向精密量子计量需要电子可追溯、可扩展且紧凑的电流源，传统电子计数方案在可扩展性和噪声抑制方面存在限制，因此需要一种可扩展的电子计数电流单元与架构。
AI.method: 采用浮栅架构的多数电子输运（MET）器件，利用传感器的非破坏性多次读出能力控制注入、输运和精确量化离散电荷包；改造电荷注入技术以受控生成量子化电荷包；探索基于并联与串联多放大器配置的可扩展架构。
AI.result: 实验结果确认噪声随独立测量数的平方根降低，并展示出稳定、可编程的输出电流。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为电子计数电流源和精密量子计量应用提供了一个紧凑、可扩展的平台。

title: Transitions between bulk and interfacial fracture in diamond/$c$BN heterostructures
summary: Whether an initially crack-free heterostructure fails at its interface or within an adjoining phase is controlled by the relative cohesion of competing atomic planes, but how interfacial chemistry, crystallographic orientation, and intermixing reshape this competition remains unclear. Here, we combine density functional theory (DFT) with a fine-tuned atomistic foundation model to resolve tensile fracture in coherent diamond/cubic boron nitride (cBN) heterostructures. The resulting potential reproduces independent DFT tensile responses, including an unseen (001) interface orientation. Interfacial termination, orientation, and diffusion-induced intermixing jointly determine fracture resistance and fracture-plane selection. C-N-bonded (111) and C-B-bonded (001) remain interface-controlled throughout the investigated intermixing range, whereas pristine C-B-bonded (111) fractures at a neighboring B-N plane inside cBN because the interface is more strongly bound. Increasing the diffusion fraction from 0 to 50.0% causes a nonlinear decrease in fracture strength from 50.3 to 15.8 GPa and drives a bulk-to-interface transition through three regimes: cBN fracture up to 4.86%, configuration-dependent competition between 7.6 and 10.1%, and interfacial fracture at 12.5% and above. Atom-resolved stress fields and DFT separation energetics show that this transition is associated with stress relocation and a reversal in the relative cohesion of competing planes, while electron localization analysis connects the cohesion hierarchy to termination- and orientation-dependent bonding. These results establish an atomistic framework for controlling fracture resistance and fracture pathways in strongly bonded heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该论文结合DFT与精调原子基础模型，研究金刚石/cBN异质结的拉伸断裂，揭示界面化学、取向与互混如何决定断裂强度与断裂面选择。
AI.motivation: 无初始裂纹的异质结究竟在界面还是相邻相内断裂，取决于竞争原子面的相对结合强度，但界面化学、晶体取向与互混如何重塑这一竞争关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 用密度泛函理论(DFT)结合精调的原子级基础模型，构建能重现独立DFT拉伸响应（含未见过的(001)界面取向）的势函数，模拟金刚石/cBN共格异质结的拉伸断裂。
AI.result: 界面终止方式、取向与扩散互混共同决定断裂抗力与断裂面。C-N键合(111)与C-B键合(001)在整个互混范围内均为界面控制断裂；纯净C-B键合(111)因界面结合更强而在cBN内邻近B-N面断裂。互混分数从0增至50.0%使断裂强度从50.3 GPa非线性降至15.8 GPa，并驱动体相→界面转变，经历三个区间：≤4.86%时cBN断裂、7.6–10.1%时构型依赖竞争、≥12.5%时界面断裂。原子分辨应力场与DFT分离能表明该转变源于应力重分布与竞争面相对结合力反转，电子局域分析将其与终止和取向相关的键合联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了控制强键合异质结断裂抗力与断裂路径的原子尺度框架。

title: Polar vibrational excitations and glass-like response in relaxor PMN
summary: Relaxor ferroelectrics retain crystalline order while exhibiting glass-like dielectric and thermal responses. Using atomistic models trained on first-principles data, we investigate these responses in the prototypical relaxor Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O_3 (PMN). Compositional disorder couples elastic motion to electric polarization, producing a continuum of polar vibrational excitations, unlike the discrete polar optical modes of conventional ferroelectric PbTiO_3. The simulations qualitatively reproduce the temperature dependence of the low-frequency susceptibility, while the calculated far-infrared spectra agree closely with experiments. At low frequencies, disorder in PMN generates a boson peak comprising excess phonon-like modes and quasi-localized excitations. The latter exhibit a quartic frequency dependence of their density of states and pronounced anharmonicity, as in structural glasses. These excess modes account for PMN's anomalous behavior in the specific heat for temperature higher than 5 K. These results connect the dielectric, optical, and thermal anomalies of a crystalline relaxor through its disorder-induced polar excitation spectrum.

AI.tldr: 利用第一性原理训练的原子模型研究弛豫铁电体PMN，揭示无序诱导的极性激发谱如何统一解释其介电、光学与热学异常。
AI.motivation: 弛豫铁电体保持晶态长程有序，却表现出类似玻璃的介电与热学响应，二者看似矛盾，其微观机制尚不清晰。
AI.method: 构建基于第一性原理数据的原子尺度模型，对典型弛豫铁电体PMN进行模拟，分析成分无序如何耦合弹性运动与电极化。
AI.result: 成分无序产生连续极性振动激发（不同于PbTiO3的离散极性光学模式）；模拟再现低频磁化率随温度的变化，远红外谱与实验吻合；低频处无序产生玻色峰（含过量类声子模式与准局域激发），后者态密度呈四次方频率依赖并具强非谐性；过量模式解释了5 K以上比热的异常。
AI.conclusion: 晶态弛豫铁电体的介电、光学和热学异常通过其无序诱导的极性激发谱被统一联系起来。

title: Heterogeneous planar diffusion with axisymmetric power-law decaying diffusion coefficient under stochastic resetting
summary: We analyse two-dimensional isotropic heterogeneous diffusion with a radially decaying diffusion coefficient $D(ρ)=D_0/ρ^2$, subject to Poissonian stochastic resetting to the origin. Since multiplicative noise makes the process interpretation-dependent, we treat the Itô, Stratonovich, and Hänggi--Klimontovich prescriptions within a single approach. For each, we obtain the exact probability density function, the non-equilibrium stationary state induced by resetting, the mean squared displacement, and the first-passage properties. The non-equilibrium stationary state is governed by modified Bessel functions and departs from the Laplace form found for homogeneous diffusion under resetting, while the mean squared displacement saturates at long times as $\langleρ^2\rangle\sim\bar{r}^{-1/2}$, $\bar{r}$ being the resetting rate. The mean first-passage time to an absorbing boundary exhibits an optimal resetting rate at which it is minimised. In addition, we incorporate memory effects through a subordination (continuous-time random walk) approach with a power-law kernel, deriving the fractional Fokker--Planck equation together with the non-equilibrium stationary state, the mean squared displacement expressed via the three-parameter Mittag-Leffler function, and the first-passage statistics; the optimal resetting rate increases as the memory exponent decreases.

AI.tldr: 研究二维径向衰减扩散系数在泊松重置下的行为，统一分析Itô、Stratonovich、Hänggi-Klimontovich解释，并加入记忆效应。
AI.motivation: 乘性噪声使过程依赖随机积分解释，同时重置与反常扩散/记忆效应的结合需要统一框架来刻画。
AI.method: 对D(ρ)=D0/ρ²的二维各向同性异质扩散加泊松重置，用统一方法处理三种积分规定；再用从属（CTRW）与幂律核推导分数Fokker-Planck方程。
AI.result: 得到各解释下的精确概率密度、非平衡稳态（修正Bessel函数，非Laplace型）、均方位移⟨ρ²⟩~r̄^{-1/2}饱和及首达性质；记忆情形下均方位移用三参数Mittag-Leffler表示，最优重置率随记忆指数减小而增大。
AI.conclusion: 径向衰减扩散与重置导致与均匀扩散不同的稳态和饱和行为，且首达时间存在最优重置率，记忆效应增强时最优重置率上升。

title: Raman Scattering Evidence for Fluctuating Kagome-Plane Moments in $\mathrm{B} \parallel [111]$ in Pr$_2$Zr$_2$O$_7$ pyrochlore
summary: The exotic magnetic properties of the pyrochlore Pr$_2$Zr$_2$O$_7$ are determined by the coupling of spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom. Magnetism in this material originates from the non-Kramers Pr$^{3+}$ ion, and the exotic behavior has been discussed both in the framework of dipole-quadrupole properties of magnetic moments and disorder splitting the non-Kramers doublet. We use magneto-Raman spectroscopy to probe the crystal electric field (CEF) excitations of Pr$^{3+}$ in magnetic fields up to 14 T applied along the [100] and [111] crystallographic directions at 2 K. For $\mathrm{B}\parallel[100]$, the field evolution of the Raman active crystal field modes is quantitatively described by conventional Zeeman splitting of the Pr$^{3+}$ ground state doublet, including the thermally populated upper Zeeman branch at elevated temperature. For $\mathrm{}{B}\parallel[111]$, the spectra separate into responses from the triangular and kagome sublattices, and the CEF excitations of Pr$^{3+}$ on the triangular lattice exhibit the expected Zeeman shift consistent with full moments polarization. In contrast, the CEF excitations of Pr$^{3+}$ on the kagome lattice do not split as expected and instead broaden strongly with increasing field. This behavior is inconsistent with a static polarized configuration and is captured phenomenologically by a motional-narrowing description in which the kagome plane moments fluctuate between Zeeman-split levels on a meV timescale. This result offers a natural explanation for the reduced magnetization observed in $\mathrm{}{B}\parallel[111]$ and provides further evidence of the dipole-quadrupole properties of magnetic moments. It highlights Raman scattering as a sensitive probe of exotic spin-orbital dynamics in frustrated magnets.

AI.tldr: 利用磁拉曼光谱研究Pr₂Zr₂O₇中Pr³⁺的晶体电场激发，发现[111]方向下kagome晶格磁矩在meV时间尺度涨落，解释了磁化减弱现象。
AI.motivation: Pr₂Zr₂O₇的奇异磁性由自旋、轨道和晶格自由度耦合决定，其机制存在偶极-四极矩框架与无序劈裂非Kramers双重态两种解释，需要实验探针澄清。
AI.method: 在2 K下对Pr₂Zr₂O₇进行磁拉曼光谱测量，施加沿[100]和[111]方向最高14 T的磁场，探测Pr³⁺的晶体电场激发。
AI.result: B∥[100]时晶体电场模的场演化符合常规Zeeman劈裂；B∥[111]时三角晶格Pr³⁺呈现预期的完全磁矩极化Zeeman位移，而kagome晶格Pr³⁺不劈裂反而强烈展宽，可用meV时间尺度的运动窄化描述。
AI.conclusion: kagome面磁矩的涨落为[111]方向磁化减弱提供自然解释，支持磁矩的偶极-四极性质，并表明拉曼散射是探测阻挫磁体中奇异自旋-轨道动力学的灵敏手段。
