title: The Superconducting Talbot Effect in Phased-Array Josephson Junctions
summary: We introduce the superconducting Talbot effect---a macroscopic quantum self-imaging phenomenon occurring when proximitized Cooper pairs propagate through a ballistic two-dimensional electron gas. By configuring periodic superconducting leads into a phased-array Josephson junction with programmable phase differences, we demonstrate active steering of the resulting superconducting Talbot carpet. To overcome transport resolution limits, we design a Vernier-scale collector array that performs sub-wavelength sampling of the fractional Talbot pattern. This approach maps real-space quantum interference with high robustness to disorder, enabling direct extraction of Fermi wavelengths across helical, spin-degenerate, and spin-orbit-split Fermi surfaces. Tight-binding numerical calculations on a square lattice validate the real-space interference patterns. Our results establish a versatile framework for coherent wavefront engineering and quantum materials diagnostics in superconducting optics.

AI.tldr: 提出超导Talbot效应：近邻库珀对在弹道二维电子气中传播时产生宏观量子自成像，并通过相控阵约瑟夫森结实现主动调控。
AI.motivation: 传统Talbot效应多为光学现象，作者希望在超导/量子输运体系中实现并主动操控自成像，同时克服输运分辨率对亚波长图案采样的限制，用于量子材料诊断。
AI.method: 将周期性超导电极构造成具有可编程相位差的相控阵约瑟夫森结，使近邻库珀对在弹道2DEG中传播；并设计Vernier刻度收集器阵列对分数Talbot图案进行亚波长采样；用方格子紧束缚数值计算验证实空间干涉图样。
AI.result: 实现了超导Talbot地毯的主动转向；Vernier收集阵列可高鲁棒性地映射实空间量子干涉，并直接提取螺旋、自旋简并及自旋轨道劈裂费米面的费米波长；紧束缚计算与实空间干涉图样一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为超导光学中的相干波前工程和量子材料诊断建立了通用框架。

title: Non-equilibrium dynamics of drift-diffusion process under threshold resetting
summary: We study the emergence of non-equilibrium steady states (NESS) in stochastic processes under threshold resetting, an event-driven protocol in which the system resets to its initial configuration upon crossing a prescribed spatial boundary (threshold). In contrast to externally driven resetting, whose steady-state properties are well understood, the behavior under threshold resetting remains largely unexplored. We derive general conditions for the existence of a NESS and show that, whenever it exists, the steady state at a given position $x$ can be expressed as the ratio of two fundamental quantities: the mean local time (MLT) at $x$ and the mean first-passage time (MFPT) to hit the threshold. In particular, for noisy systems, a finite MFPT guarantees the existence of a NESS. As an illustrative example, we analyze a drift-diffusion process in one dimension and uncover rich intermediate-time dynamics, including anomalous relaxation in the spatial distribution, damped oscillations in the moments and in the mean-squared displacement (MSD), governed by system parameters. Our findings provide a general understanding of the emergence of non-equilibrium steady states and relaxation dynamics under threshold resetting, revealing how induced events shape the spatial and temporal properties of a broad class of stochastic processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阈值重置（跨越空间边界即重置到初始构型）下的非平衡稳态（NESS）涌现。推导了NESS存在的通用条件，证明稳态分布等于平均局部时间与平均首达时间之比；以一维漂移扩散为例揭示异常弛豫与阻尼振荡等丰富中间动力学。
AI.motivation: 外部驱动重置的稳态性质已较清楚，但阈值重置（事件驱动、系统自主触发）下的稳态行为几乎未被探索，需理解其非平衡稳态涌现与弛豫动力学。
AI.method: 针对阈值重置随机过程，推导NESS存在的通用条件；将稳态分布表示为平均局部时间(MLT)与击中阈值的平均首达时间(MFPT)之比；以一维漂移扩散过程为具体算例进行分析。
AI.result: 证明只要NESS存在，位置x处稳态可写成MLT与MFPT之比；对有噪声系统，有限MFPT即保证NESS存在。一维漂移扩散中观察到空间分布的异常弛豫、矩及均方位移的阻尼振荡，受系统参数调控。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了阈值重置下非平衡稳态涌现与弛豫动力学的一般理解，揭示诱导事件如何塑造一大类随机过程的空间与时间性质。

title: Highly Lattice-Mismatched Selective Area Epitaxy and Coalescence of PbSe Nanostructures on GaAs
summary: Selective area growth of PbSe has the potential to realize deterministic placement of high-density, defect-tolerant nanostructure networks toward a scalable quantum platform. PbSe is a narrow bandgap semiconductor with advantageous (opto)electronic properties that has been shown to have a desirable defect-tolerance, enabling bright emission even when grown on highly-dissimilar platforms, and could be leveraged in combination with selective growth for site-selective quantum emitters and low-disorder hybrid nanowire networks. In this work, we achieve site-selective growth of well-faceted and ordered PbSe nanostructures, despite a large 8% lattice mismatch. Structural and morphological characterization reveal that $>$99% of selectively grown islands within 100 nm opening are single-orientation and cube-on-cube oriented with sub-nm root-mean-square surface roughness. Defect analysis showed that 74% of the islands and 86% of the coalesced regions between different mask openings were free of threading dislocations. These PbSe islands achieved equivalent emission in the mid-infrared despite having a higher surface-to-volume ratio than the planar control. Further, we present a gate-tunable two-terminal Josephson junction fabricated from the PbSe nanowires grown with conditions identified in this study. The combination of the accessible selective growth regime, morphological control of island growth and demonstrations of optical and electrical transport properties indicates promise for PbSe SAG as a defect-tolerant scalable quantum platform.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了PbSe的选择性区域生长（SAG），在8%晶格失配下获得取向一致、低缺陷的纳米结构，并展示其中红外发光与可栅控约瑟夫森结，验证其作为缺陷容忍可扩展量子平台的潜力。
AI.motivation: PbSe具窄带隙与优异缺陷容忍性，可实现高密度纳米结构的确定性放置，结合选择性生长有望构建位点选择性量子发射器与低无序混合纳米线网络，推动可扩展量子平台。
AI.method: 在100 nm掩模开口内选择性生长PbSe纳米结构（尽管存在8%晶格失配），进行结构与形貌表征、缺陷分析，测量中红外发光，并制备栅控两端约瑟夫森结。
AI.result: >99%选择性生长岛为单一取向、cube-on-cube取向，表面粗糙度亚纳米级；74%的岛及86%的合并区域无穿透位错；PbSe岛在更大表面体积比下仍获得与平面对照相当的中红外发光；成功制备栅可调两端约瑟夫森结。
AI.conclusion: 可及的选择性生长窗口、形貌控制及光学/电学输运演示表明PbSe SAG是有前景的缺陷容忍可扩展量子平台。

title: Infrared evidence for strong $C_{3}$ symmetry breaking in 1$T$-TiSe$_{2}$
summary: The interplay between lattice and electron degrees of freedom gives rise to competing ordered states in quantum materials, which can lead to a series of subsequent symmetry breaking transitions. While the differences are often subtle, these phases can be distinguished by their remaining point group symmetries. Here, we use infrared optical spectroscopy to probe symmetry breaking at the charge density wave transition of 1$T$-TiSe$_{2}$. We uncover a previously unobserved splitting of a doubly degenerate $E_u$ optical phonon at $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx$ 190 K that constitutes direct evidence for the breaking of three-fold rotational symmetry. Our finding rules out proposals where the CDW transition to a low temperature chiral or nematic phase takes place through an intermediary state that preserves three-fold symmetry. The energy difference between the two former $E_{u}$ partners can only be explained by large $C_{3}$ breaking distortions of the same order of magnitude as previously observed changes in bond lengths, suggesting that $C_{3}$ symmetry breaking plays a dominant role in the CDW transition. The linewidth of the single phonon mode above $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ could be consistent with a fluctuating state where three-fold symmetry is also broken.

AI.tldr: 利用红外光谱研究1T-TiSe₂电荷密度波转变，发现E_u声子分裂，直接证明三重旋转对称性破缺。
AI.motivation: 量子材料中晶格与电子自由度的相互作用会产生竞争有序态，导致系列对称性破缺转变。区分这些相的关键在于其剩余点群对称性，但差异往往很微小，需要敏感的实验手段来探测。
AI.method: 采用红外光学光谱技术探测1T-TiSe₂的电荷密度波（CDW）转变，通过观测光学声子的分裂来表征对称性破缺。
AI.result: 在T_CDW≈190 K处观测到双简并E_u光学声子的分裂，这是三重旋转对称性破缺的直接证据；两个原E_u伙伴模式的能量差只能用与键长变化同量级的大C₃破缺畸变来解释；T_CDW以上单一声子模式的线宽可能与三重对称性破缺的涨落态一致。
AI.conclusion: 该发现排除了CDW通过保持三重对称性的中间态转变为低温手性或向列相的方案，表明C₃对称性破缺在CDW转变中起主导作用。

title: Corbino-Enhanced Supersonic Acoustic-Emission Threshold in a GaAs Two-Dimensional Electron System
summary: We report nonlinear differential-resistance measurements in a high-mobility GaAs/AlGaAs two-dimensional electron system patterned in a Corbino geometry. At zero magnetic field, $R_{\mathrm{diff}}(I_{dc})$ exhibits a pronounced polarity-selective threshold peak on the negative-current branch, gradually suppressed by a perpendicular magnetic field. We interpret the Corbino anomaly as a local Cherenkov-like threshold for acoustic phonon emission, enabled by the radial current concentration $j_r(r)=I/(2πr)$, which drives the local electron velocity above the sound velocity in a region adjacent to the inner contact. The polarity selectivity is attributed to Peltier heating and cooling, which modify the local thermal and boundary conditions near the contact, rather than to the kinematic threshold itself. Our results identify the Corbino geometry as a sensitive platform for probing local nonequilibrium electron--phonon processes in a high-mobility electron system within an independently established hydrodynamic-crossover regime and suggest that the inner Corbino contact can act as a geometry-defined source for supersonic acoustic emission.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了高迁移率GaAs/AlGaAs二维电子系统在Corbino几何下的非线性微分电阻，观测到零磁场下负电流支上的极性选择性阈值峰，并解释为声学声子发射的局域类切伦科夫阈值。
AI.motivation: Corbino几何中径向电流密度集中可让局域电子速度超过声速，为探测高迁移率电子系统中局域非平衡电子-声子过程提供敏感平台。
AI.method: 在Corbino构型的高迁移率GaAs/AlGaAs二维电子系统中测量微分电阻R_diff(I_dc)随直流电流与垂直磁场的变化。
AI.result: 零磁场下R_diff在负电流支出现显著极性选择性阈值峰，并随垂直磁场逐渐被抑制。
AI.conclusion: Corbino异常源于声学声子发射的局域类切伦科夫阈值；极性选择性归因于Peltier加热与冷却，内接触可作为几何限定的超声声发射源。

title: Effective Mass Approach to Dynamics of Non-Markovian Systems with Short Memory
comment: Doctoral dissertation in a form of a guide through a collection of scientific articles (with minor corrections after the review). Written under the supervision of Jakub Spiechowicz. 53 pages, 12 figures + 1 logo
summary: Memory is an inherent feature of the dynamics of physical systems. It typically emerges when the complex structure of the system is simplified during the modeling process, obscuring a part of its underlying behavior. Consequently, the correct description of such a physical model requires knowledge of not only its present, but also its past states, leading to non-Markovian dynamics. The resulting interactions depending on the system history, however, introduce a significant layer of mathematical complexity. For this reason, when the memory time is significantly shorter than the time scales characterizing the dynamics, it is typically neglected at the cost of losing information regarding its role in the system behavior. In this dissertation, I introduce a novel methodology, namely the effective mass approach, which bridges the Markovian and non-Markovian regimes and provides an accessible framework for analyzing systems with short memory. In this method, the non-Markovian system is approximated with its Markovian counterpart, in which the short-memory effects are encapsulated within an effective mass. I then utilize this approach to demonstrate that the impact of short memory on physical dynamics can be remarkably pronounced. In particular, I show that the directed transport of a Brownian particle in an environment exhibiting temporal correlations can be reversed relative to its behavior in a memoryless medium. Moreover, I propose a setup wherein memory serves as a~control parameter for the generation of random information bits. Collectively, the results of this dissertation underscore the critical importance of short-time correlations in microscopic systems.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出"有效质量方法"，连接马尔可夫与非马尔可夫区域，揭示短时记忆对物理动力学的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 物理系统建模中简化复杂结构会掩盖底层行为，导致非马尔可夫动力学。记忆依赖使数学复杂度大增，当记忆时间远短于动力学时间尺度时通常被忽略，但这会丢失记忆对系统行为作用的信息。
AI.method: 提出"有效质量方法"：将非马尔可夫系统近似为其马尔可夫对应物，把短记忆效应封装在有效质量中，从而连接两种区域并提供易用的分析框架。
AI.result: 利用该方法展示短记忆对物理动力学的显著影响：在具有时间相关性的环境中，布朗粒子的定向输运方向可相对于无记忆介质发生反转；并提出以记忆作为控制参数生成随机信息比特的方案。
AI.conclusion: 本论文结果表明短时相关性在微观系统中具有关键重要性。

title: GRAINSMITH: A Generator of Polycrystalline Models for Atomistic Simulations with Statistical and Grain-Boundary Morphology Control
summary: Atomistic studies of grain-boundary engineering, grain-size effects and dopant enrichment require reproducible models with prescribed microstructural features. We present GRAINSMITH, an open-source Python package for generating statistically controlled polycrystalline models with selectable grain-boundary morphologies for molecular dynamics and subsequent relaxation. Within supported feature combinations, a single configuration specifies grain-size and volume distributions, crystallographic texture, boundary-area-weighted disorientation-angle distributions, phase composition and grain-boundary dopant placement. Crystal construction supports 230 crystallographic space groups. Periodic Voronoi and volume-targeted Laguerre tessellations provide planar boundaries, while distinct geometry backends generate smoothly curved and band-limited self-affine boundaries. A registry of twenty-six checks assesses applicable inputs, construction properties and outputs. Each run exports LAMMPS data and Extended XYZ files together with structural and statistical descriptors and machine-readable provenance. For a fixed software version and computational environment, the configuration and random seed determine byte-reproducible atomic configurations and scientific data across supported worker counts. By combining statistical specification, boundary-morphology control and reproducible atomistic output, GRAINSMITH supports systematic studies of microstructural effects and quantitative comparisons across generated models.

AI.tldr: GRAINSMITH 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成具有统计可控性、可选晶界形貌的多晶原子模型，输出可用于分子动力学模拟的可复现 LAMMPS/XYZ 文件及统计描述符。
AI.motivation: 晶界工程、晶粒尺寸效应与掺杂富集等原子尺度研究需要具备规定微观结构特征且可复现的模型，现有工具难以同时实现统计控制与多种晶界形貌生成。
AI.method: 单一配置即可指定晶粒尺寸与体积分布、晶体织构、按边界面积加权的取向差分布、相组成及晶界掺杂位置；支持230个空间群，采用周期性 Voronoi 与体积目标 Laguerre 铺分生成平面晶界，并有几何后端生成平滑弯曲与带限自仿射晶界；含26项输入/属性/输出检查。
AI.result: 每次运行导出 LAMMPS data 和 Extended XYZ 文件，附结构/统计描述符与机器可读溯源信息；在固定版本与环境及随机种子下，跨不同并行工作数仍可实现字节级可复现的原子构型与科学数据。
AI.conclusion: GRAINSMITH 结合统计规格、晶界形貌控制与可复现原子输出，支持微观结构效应的系统研究与跨模型定量比较。

title: Rapidly prototyping kagome flat band physics with acoustic metamaterials
summary: Flat bands with vanishing group velocity and quenched kinetic energy provide fertile ground for correlated states and exotic phenomena such as unconventional superconductivity. Yet, engineering and characterizing flat bands in quantum materials is time-consuming and costly, limiting the exploration of the vast design space of possible flat band systems. Acoustic metamaterials offer an accessible alternative: they can be easily simulated, cheaply fabricated, and quickly measured. Here we present a complete workflow to rapidly prototype flat band systems using acoustic metamaterials. Our design directly implements a tight-binding model using air cavities as lattice sites connected by channels that control hopping, allowing it to generalize to diverse lattice geometries. Using the kagome lattice as a proof-of-concept, we demonstrate excellent agreement between tight-binding theory, finite-element simulations, and experimental measurements. We then design a family of extended kagome lattices whose added sites cancel successively longer-range hopping, flattening the flat band. With fabrication and measurement requiring hours rather than months and a total cost orders of magnitude lower than quantum materials, our approach enables rapid iteration through candidate lattices, facilitating the discovery of new flat band physics in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用声学超材料快速原型化平带系统的完整工作流程，以kagome晶格为概念验证，实现紧束缚理论、有限元模拟与实验的高度一致，并设计扩展kagome晶格家族以消除长程跃迁、进一步平坦化平带。
AI.motivation: 平带（群速度为零、动能被淬灭）是关联态与非常规超导等奇异现象的沃土，但在量子材料中工程化与表征平带耗时且昂贵，限制了对其庞大数据设计空间的探索。声学超材料易于模拟、制造成本低、测量快速，提供了可及的替代方案。
AI.method: 设计直接用空气腔作为格点、用通道连接并控制跃迁，从而直接实现紧束缚模型，可推广至多种晶格几何。以kagome晶格为概念验证，对比紧束缚理论、有限元模拟与实验测量；并设计一族扩展kagome晶格，通过增加格点逐次抵消更长程跃迁以平坦化平带。
AI.result: 紧束缚理论、有限元模拟与实验测量三者高度一致；扩展kagome晶格家族通过抵消逐次更长程的跃迁成功使平带更平坦。制造与测量仅需数小时（而非数月），总成本比量子材料低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该声学超材料工作流程可实现对候选晶格的快速迭代，有助于在量子材料中发现新的平带物理。

title: Observation of Kondo Effect in Rhombohedral Graphene Superlattices
summary: Kondo effect in strongly correlated systems arises from the antiferromagnetic coupling between itinerant conduction electrons and localized magnetic moments, giving rise to a variety of exotic quantum phenomena. Two-dimensional moiré superlattice systems provide a highly tunable platform featuring topological flat bands, where Wannier orbitals are spatially confined by the periodic moiré potential and serve as localized magnetic moments, enabling the observable Kondo effect. Here we experimentally demonstrate Kondo interactions in hexalayer rhombohedral graphene moiré superlattices through magneto-transport and temperature-dependent measurements. With increasing magnetic field, the magnetoresistance exhibits an increase-decrease transition across a critical field B_c, while the Hall resistance R_xy undergoes a sign reversal near B_c. Moreover, as temperature decreases, the longitudinal resistance R_xx first increases logarithmically and then decreases following a T^2 behavior, indicating a transition to heavy fermion liquid. These behaviors can be consistently explained by the breakdown of Kondo singlets induced by either magnetic field or temperature, which liberates carriers previously bound to localized moments, thereby enhancing conductivity and altering the dominant carrier type. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that the Kondo interaction can be continuously tuned by both carrier density n and displacement electric field D, and suggest the emergence of a Kondo insulating state. Our findings provide deep insight into the Kondo effect in moiré engineered flat-band systems, paving the path for exploring exotic correlated quantum phases.

AI.tldr: 本文在六层菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格中通过磁输运和变温测量实验观测到近藤效应，并可通过载流子密度和位移电场调控。
AI.motivation: 莫尔超晶格具有拓扑平带，其中Wannier轨道受周期莫尔势局域化，可作为局域磁矩，为研究近藤效应提供高度可调的二维平台，本文旨在实验验证该体系中的近藤相互作用。
AI.method: 对六层菱方石墨烯莫尔超晶格进行磁输运与温度依赖测量，分析磁阻随磁场的增减转变、霍尔电阻在临界场B_c附近的符号反转，以及纵向电阻随温度先对数增加后按T^2下降的行为，并调控载流子密度n与位移电场D。
AI.result: 随磁场增大，磁阻在临界场B_c处出现先增后减转变，霍尔电阻R_xy在B_c附近发生符号反转；降温时R_xx先对数增长后呈T^2下降，表明体系转变为重费米液体。这些现象可由磁场或温度破坏近藤单态、释放原本束缚于局域磁矩的载流子来解释，并提示近藤绝缘态的出现。
AI.conclusion: 近藤相互作用可通过载流子密度和位移电场连续调控，并暗示近藤绝缘态的存在，为莫尔工程平带体系中的近藤效应及奇异关联量子相研究提供了新途径。

title: Lowest-known Energy Configuration of $N=100\,000$ Coulomb Charges in a Disk: Breaking the $10^{5}$ Barrier
comment: Article: 12 pages, 1 table; Supplemental Material: 6 pages, 6 figures, 1 table
summary: We report the first calculation of the lowest-known energy configuration for $N=100\,000$ classical point charges confined to a disk and interacting via the $1/r$ Coulomb potential - a system size never before achieved for the Thomson problem in a disk, more than doubling the previous record of $N=40\,886$ reported by Amore and Zarate. An adaptive defect-targeting subdomain optimization strategy yields an approximately linear growth of the wall-clock time per cycle with $N$; for $N=100\,000$ a single $24$-core CPU workstation without GPU acceleration required $\approx31$ hours. The energy $E_{\min}=7.80466624157\times10^{9}$ deviates from the asymptotic expansion fitted to $100\le N\le5000$ data by only $2.525\times10^{-7}$, providing a stringent test of its extrapolation to unprecedented scales. Bond-orientational order analysis reveals a polycrystalline bulk threaded by radial grain boundaries, establishing a new benchmark for two-dimensional Coulomb systems.

AI.tldr: 首次计算圆盘内N=100000个经典点电荷（1/r库仑势）的最低能量构型，刷新Thomson问题圆盘体系记录（此前N=40886），并给出高精度能量与多晶结构特征。
AI.motivation: 圆盘Thomson问题此前最大规模仅N=40886，缺乏对超大N下渐近展开外推的严格检验，也缺乏对二维库仑体系在极端尺度下结构（晶界、取向序）的基准。
AI.method: 采用自适应缺陷定位的子域优化策略（adaptive defect-targeting subdomain optimization），在无GPU的24核CPU工作站上计算单周期墙钟时间随N近似线性增长；对N=100000运行约31小时得到最低能量构型，并进行键取向序分析。
AI.result: 得到E_min=7.80466624157×10^9，与基于100≤N≤5000数据拟合的渐近展开仅偏差2.525×10^-7；结构分析显示多晶内部由径向晶界贯穿。单周期墙钟时间随N近似线性增长（N=100000需约31小时）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将圆盘Thomson问题的可计算规模翻倍以上，证明渐近展开可高精度外推到N=100000，并揭示径向晶界贯穿的多晶结构，为二维库仑系统建立新基准。

title: Avalanche Size and Interevent Time Statistics in Amorphous System
summary: The intermittent, stick-slip flow of amorphous systems is characterized by avalanches whose statistical properties display robust power-laws. In this paper, we study avalanche statistics in a field theoretical model of a soft-glassy system under shear. The order parameter in our model is the fluidity, which is related to the local rate of plastic events in a soft-glass. While avalanche sizes $S$ have been extensively characterized, the statistics of interevent times $t_i$ have remained largely unexplored. Here, we find that both $S$ and $t_i$ are power-law distributed and that their scaling exponents satisfy a precise relation. The model enables the analytical derivation of the scaling exponents and the reproduction of the behavior observed across a wide class of amorphous systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文在软玻璃系统剪切场理论模型中研究雪崩统计，发现雪崩尺寸S与事件间隔时间t_i均服从幂律分布，且标度指数满足精确关系，可解析推导并复现多种非晶系统的观测行为。
AI.motivation: 非晶系统间歇性黏滑流由雪崩主导，其统计性质呈现稳健幂律。雪崩尺寸S已被广泛研究，但事件间隔时间t_i的统计仍缺乏探索，本文旨在填补这一空白并揭示S与t_i之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用剪切作用下软玻璃系统的场论模型，以流体度（fluidity）为序参量，与软玻璃中局部塑性事件的速率相关，进而分析雪崩尺寸与事件间隔时间的统计规律。
AI.result: 发现雪崩尺寸S和事件间隔时间t_i均呈幂律分布，且两者的标度指数满足精确关系；模型可解析导出这些标度指数，并复现广泛非晶系统中的观测行为。
AI.conclusion: 该理论模型成功统一了雪崩尺寸与间隔时间的统计描述，提供了标度指数的解析推导，适用于广泛的非晶系统。

title: Three-dimensional atom-by-atom measurement of interface diffusion dynamics
summary: Diffusion at interfaces governs how materials and devices form, evolve and function. It is usually measured through smooth concentration profiles and bulk transport coefficients, which average over the discrete atomic rearrangements. At nanoscale interfaces only a few atomic layers wide, however, such coarse-graining obscures the local three-dimensional (3D) atomic transport, and scalar diffusion coefficients cannot fully describe species-, layer- and facet-resolved redistribution. The essential observable is the discrete 3D redistribution of atoms themselves, beyond an averaged profile. Here we combine micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) pulse-quench heating with atomic electron tomography (AET) to reconstruct five 3D atomic configurations of the same coherent Pd@Pt core-shell nanoparticle, each corresponding to a well-defined thermal state. Species-conserving one-to-one assignment links neighbouring configurations, and labelled reference simulations correct the displacement bias caused by indistinguishable same-species atoms. The corrected Pd diffusivities follow Arrhenius behaviour, giving an apparent activation energy of 1.10 eV, consistent with migration-limited vacancy-mediated transport. Atomic-layer transition statistics further show that increasing 3D mobility can coexist with declining net chemical transfer and reveal facet-dependent pathways hidden by the scalar diffusivity. Together, these measurements establish a 3D atom-by-atom framework that connects identity-corrected mobility to species-, layer- and facet-resolved transport at buried nanointerfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文结合MEMS脉冲淬火加热与原子电子断层扫描(AET),重建同一Pd@Pt核壳纳米颗粒在多个热态下的3D原子构型,建立原子级、身份校正的3D扩散测量框架。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度界面仅数原子层宽,传统平滑浓度剖面与宏观扩散系数会平均掉离散原子重排,无法描述物种、层与晶面分辨的3D原子输运;关键观测量应是原子本身的离散3D重分布。
AI.method: MEMS脉冲淬火加热+AET重建5个同一Pd@Pt核壳颗粒的3D原子构型;用物种守恒的一对一配准关联相邻构型;用带标记参考模拟校正同种原子不可区分导致的位移偏差。
AI.result: 校正后Pd扩散率符合Arrhenius行为,表观激活能1.10 eV,与迁移受限的空位介导输运一致;原子层跃迁统计显示3D迁移率升高可与净化学转移下降共存,并揭示被标量扩散率掩盖的晶面依赖路径。
AI.conclusion: 建立了连接身份校正迁移率与物种/层/晶面分辨输运的3D逐原子框架,可用于埋藏纳米界面的扩散研究。

title: Anisotropic Surface State Band Splitting and Low Energy Flat Bands in 3d Correlated Topological Kondo Insulator Candidate FeSb$_2$
summary: FeSb$_2$ is a correlated narrow-gap semiconductor that has often been discussed as a $3d$-electron Kondo insulator candidate and exhibits a low-temperature resistance plateau with possible surface-dominated conduction. We carried out a systematic high-resolution laser-based angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) study of FeSb$_2$ to investigate its electronic structure. The surface states around the zone center show clear anisotropic splitting. When the temperature is lowered into the resistance plateau regime ($<6\,\mathrm{K}$), the surface states remain robust, but their photoemission peaks become much sharper and gain spectral weight. Two distinct flat-band-like features are observed at low energy. One is located at $\sim$127 meV below the Fermi level, which exists only along a specific high-symmetry direction, while the other is located at $\sim$70 meV below the Fermi level and is present along all the measured momentum cuts around the zone center. These results provide new information to understand the renormalization effects, the resistance plateau, and the topological nature of FeSb$_2$.

AI.tldr: 本文用高分辨激光ARPES研究关联窄隙半导体FeSb₂的电子结构，观测到各向异性分裂的表面态和两个平带特征，为理解其重整化效应、电阻平台及拓扑性质提供新信息。
AI.motivation: FeSb₂是关联窄隙半导体，常被作为3d电子Kondo绝缘体候选者，并在低温出现电阻平台，可能由表面主导导电。其电子结构尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 对FeSb₂进行系统的高分辨激光基角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量，聚焦布里渊区中心附近的表面态及低能平带。
AI.result: 区中心周围表面态呈明显各向异性分裂；温度降至电阻平台区（<6 K）时表面态依然稳健但光电子峰更尖锐且谱重增加；观测到两个平带样特征，分别位于费米能下约127 meV（仅沿特定高对称方向）和约70 meV（所有测量动量切面）。
AI.conclusion: 结果加深了对FeSb₂重整化效应、电阻平台机制及拓扑性质的理解。

title: Quantum-interference-driven orbital density wave and high-temperature superconductivity in trilayer nickelates
summary: Intertwined charge-density-wave (CDW) and spin-density-wave (SDW) orders are a hallmark of high-temperature superconducting multilayer nickelates. In trilayer La4Ni3O_{10}, charge correlations develop at temperatures above the onset of long-range spin order, and the characteristic ordering wavevectors satisfy $Q_{cdw} \approx 2Q_{sdw}$. Here, using a density-wave equation with vertex corrections, we show that quantum interference between short-range SDW fluctuations at $q \approx Q_{sdw}$ on the outer NiO2 layers generates an inter-outer-layer bond order at $Q_{cdw} \approx 2 Q_{sdw}$. This bond order induces a pronounced inner-layer-centered orbital order, with antiphase modulations of the Ni $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ and $d_{x^2-y^2}$ occupations, producing strong orbital polarization but only weak total charge modulation. This intertwined bond-and-orbital order accounts for the layer-selective electronic reconstruction inferred from NMR/NQR and is consistent with Raman spectroscopy and scanning tunnelling microscopy measurements. The same orbital and spin fluctuations also cooperate to stabilize $s_{\pm}$-wave superconductivity through $M_z$ mirror-parity selection rules. Our results provide a unified microscopic framework for intertwined density-wave order and high-Tc superconductivity in multilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文用含顶点修正的密度波方程，揭示三层镍酸盐中由短程SDW涨落量子干涉产生的层间键序与轨道序，统一解释了密度波序与高温超导。
AI.motivation: 高温超导多层镍酸盐中CDW与SDW序交织，在三层La4Ni3O10里电荷关联先于长程自旋序出现，且Qcdw≈2Qsdw，缺乏统一微观机制。
AI.method: 采用带顶点修正的密度波方程，考虑外层NiO2上q≈Qsdw短程SDW涨落的量子干涉。
AI.result: 外层间在Qcdw≈2Qsdw生成键序，诱导内层居中的轨道序，Ni d3z2-r2与dx2-y2占据反相调制，轨道极化强而总电荷调制弱；与NMR/NQR、Raman、STM一致。
AI.conclusion: 轨道与自旋涨落通过Mz镜面宇称选择规则协同稳定s±波超导，为多层镍酸盐密度波序与高Tc超导提供统一框架。

title: Modified Low-Temperature Scanning Tunneling Microscope for Ultrafast Pump-Probe Spectroscopy
summary: Combining scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) with terahertz pulses (THz-STM) enables ultrafast dynamics of phonons, spins, and charge carriers to be probed with atomic-scale spatial and sub-picosecond temporal resolution. However, coupling THz radiation into a low-temperature STM junction presents some technical challenges as it requires optical access for laser illumination while maintaining junction stability. Instead of designing a completely new STM head with customized optical access and optics within the ultra-high vacuum chamber, we modified a Besocke "Beetle" style STM with minimal changes of the cryogenic radiation shields. Despite the given geometrical conditions, we achieved efficient coupling of THz and optical pulses to the STM junction while maintaining temperatures below 6 K. We designed the optical setup on a separate laser table, starting with femtosecond laser pulses that are used to generate THz pulses in a LiNbO$_3$ crystal. We show the obtained THz pulse shapes and determine the effective time resolution using cross-correlation measurements. We further demonstrate the stable performance of the modified STM by measuring THz-induced tunneling currents from monolayer molybdenum disulfide (MoS$_2$) grown on Au(111). The resulting current maps resolve atomic-scale contrast revealing a point defect. The measurements confirm efficient THz coupling and stable low-temperature STM operation with atomic resolution.

AI.tldr: 通过最小改动改造Besocke"甲虫"式低温STM的辐射屏蔽，实现了THz与光脉冲的高效耦合（温度<6 K），并验证了原子级分辨的THz诱导隧穿电流测量。
AI.motivation: 将THz辐射耦合进低温STM结面临技术挑战：需要激光照明的光学通道，同时保持结的稳定性。为避免设计全新的STM头及定制光学系统，作者寻求在现有商用STM基础上做最小改动。
AI.method: 改造Besocke"甲虫"式STM，仅对低温辐射屏蔽作最小修改；在独立激光台上搭建光学系统，用飞秒激光在LiNbO₃晶体中产生THz脉冲；通过互相关测量确定有效时间分辨率；对Au(111)上生长的单层MoS₂测量THz诱导隧穿电流。
AI.result: 在保持温度低于6 K的条件下实现了THz与光脉冲的高效耦合；给出了THz脉冲形状与有效时间分辨率；电流图呈现原子级对比度，并分辨出一个点缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该改造方案证实了高效THz耦合与稳定的低温STM运行，可在原子分辨率下进行THz-STM测量，为超快动力学研究提供了低成本、易实现的途径。

title: Stochastic optimisation method for estimating large deviations
summary: A stochastic optimisation method was recently proposed to efficiently compute large deviation functions, used in statistical physics to characterise the fluctuations of nonequilibrium systems, modelled as Markov processes. The method, called LDSTOP, combines numerical techniques from control theory and machine learning to iteratively construct the "driven process", a controlled version of the Markov process used as a model of nonequilibrium system that realises a given fluctuation or large deviation of that system in an optimal way. Compared to other methods based on spectral approximations, importance sampling, cloning or splitting, LDSTOP is simple, flexible, and scalable, as it works by simulating single trajectories that are gradually guided towards the driven process. Here, we illustrate these advantages by applying the method on the full range of Markov processes considered in applications, namely, discrete-time Markov chains, continuous-time jump processes, and diffusion processes. For each type, we define the objective function to be optimised, explain different options available for representing the driven process (using, e.g., neural networks), and provide implementation details through simple applications. With these contributions, we aim to showcase the method's efficiency, as well as its ease of use when combined with available machine learning packages, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and JAX, for simulating stochastic processes and solving high-dimensional optimisation problems.

AI.tldr: 介绍 LDSTOP 方法，一种结合控制论与机器学习、通过模拟单条轨迹迭代构建"驱动过程"来高效计算大偏差函数的随机优化方法，并在离散时间马尔可夫链、连续时间跳跃过程和扩散过程上展示其通用性与易用性。
AI.motivation: 大偏差函数用于刻画非平衡系统的涨落，但现有基于谱近似、重要性采样、克隆或分裂的方法往往复杂、受限或难以扩展。LDSTOP 此前被提出以克服这些问题，但尚未在各类马尔可夫过程上系统展示其适用性。
AI.method: LDSTOP 结合控制理论与机器学习，迭代构造"驱动过程"（即实现给定涨落或大偏差的最优受控马尔可夫过程）。方法通过模拟被逐步引导的单条轨迹来工作，并以神经网络等方式表示驱动过程。文中针对离散时间马尔可夫链、连续时间跳跃过程和扩散过程分别定义优化目标函数，给出驱动过程的表示选项与实现细节。
AI.result: 方法在应用中所涵盖的完整马尔可夫过程范围（离散、跳跃、扩散）上均得到验证，通过简单应用示例展示了其效率与实现细节。
AI.conclusion: LDSTOP 简单、灵活、可扩展，能方便地与 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等机器学习库结合，用于模拟随机过程和求解高维优化问题。

title: Photoresist-Free Lithography via Light-Induced Redox Patterning of Oxide Thin Films
summary: Lithographic patterning of nanoscale devices typically depends on photoresists, wet processing and multistep pattern-transfer workflows that impose both environmental and scaling constraints. Focused laser irradiation of (Ni,Co)1+2xTi1-xO3 under a reducing atmosphere drives localized oxygen removal, directly converting the insulating oxide into embedded metallic features without etching or chemical processing. Here we demonstrate a photoresist-free patterning method based on light-induced redox transformations in (Ni0.4Co0.6)3O3 (x = 1) thin films. Our results indicate that the transformation is self-limiting, as the high optical absorption of the emerging metallic phase restricts further energy penetration and confines the reduction front, producing conductive layers with electrical properties comparable to bulk metals. This reversible, orientation-preserving transformation is characteristic of a topotactic redox process, enabling direct nanoscale patterning without photoresists. The process is reversible through re-oxidation and is compatible with standard semiconductor wafer substrates. The role of Ti as a reduction inhibitor is discussed. These results establish a route to direct nanoscale patterning based on controlled redox chemistry, offering a potential alternative to conventional lithography for functional thin-film materials.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需光刻胶的直接纳米图案化方法，利用激光诱导(Ni,Co)3O3薄膜的拓扑氧化还原转变，将绝缘氧化物局部还原为嵌入的金属导电特征，过程可逆且兼容半导体晶圆。
AI.motivation: 传统纳米器件光刻依赖光刻胶、湿法工艺和多步图案转移，存在环境与规模化限制，需要一种无需蚀刻或化学处理的直接图案化替代方案。
AI.method: 在还原气氛下用聚焦激光照射(Ni,Co)1+2xTi1-xO3（特别是(Ni0.4Co0.6)3O3，x=1）薄膜，通过光诱导氧化还原反应局部去除氧，将绝缘氧化物原位转化为金属相；利用新生金属相的高光吸收实现自限制还原前沿，并研究了Ti作为还原抑制剂的作用。
AI.result: 转变呈自限制特性，还原前沿被限制，所得导电层电学性能可与块体金属相比；转变保持取向、可逆（可再氧化），兼容标准半导体晶圆衬底，实现纳米尺度直接图案化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了基于可控氧化还原化学的直接纳米图案化路线，为功能薄膜材料提供了一种潜在的传统光刻替代方案。

title: Model of the magnon Kerr effect in a highly anisotropic ferromagnet
summary: The magnon Kerr effect is a nonlinear phenomenon that occurs universally in any ferromagnet with finite magnetic anisotropy. It manifests itself as a magnon population-dependent change in the magnon dispersion relation. Here, we derive the Hamiltonian for the magnon Kerr effect for a thin film with uniaxial anisotropy. We consider the external field, parallel, perpendicular, and at an intermediate angle to the anisotropy axis, and determine the Kerr coefficient in each case. We show how the nonlinearity scales for different magnetic materials as a function of magnon frequency and magnetic sample volume. Moreover, we derive the equations of motion for a hybrid cavity-magnon system with such thin-film magnon Kerr nonlinearity, to obtain populations of photons and magnons, and scattering matrix terms for the microwave transmission of the cavity, relevant for experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 该文推导了具有单轴各向异性薄膜中磁振子Kerr效应的哈密顿量，确定了不同外场方向下的Kerr系数，并建立了杂化腔-磁振子系统的运动方程。
AI.motivation: 磁振子Kerr效应普遍存在于有限磁各向异性的铁磁体中，表现为磁振子色散随磁振子布居数变化，但需要针对薄膜及各向外场方向进行系统性理论刻画。
AI.method: 推导单轴各向异性薄膜的磁振子Kerr效应哈密顿量，分别考虑外场平行、垂直及与各向异性轴成中间角的情况，得到各情形Kerr系数；分析非线性随磁振子频率与样品体积的标度关系；建立含薄膜磁振子Kerr非线性的杂化腔-磁振子系统运动方程。
AI.result: 获得各外场方向下的Kerr系数，给出非线性对不同材料、磁振子频率和样品体积的标度规律，并求得光子与磁振子布居数及腔微波透射的散射矩阵项。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为薄膜磁振子Kerr非线性及杂化腔-磁振子系统的实验观测（如微波透射）提供了理论框架。

title: Random-matrix and transport frequencies in eigenstate spectral functions
summary: The fact that generic isolated many-body quantum systems thermalize is understood using the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH). In recent years, there has been much interest in the behavior of the ETH spectral functions, which characterize the smooth dependence of the variance of the off-diagonal matrix elements of observables on the associated energy and frequency, and whose low-frequency part contains information about the long-time dynamics. In finite systems described by the ETH, the spectral functions are expected to exhibit plateaus below a characteristic frequency $ω^{}_{\mathrm{ETH}}$. In this regime, the statistics of the matrix elements of observables are expected to be described by random matrix theory. Related frequencies that have been studied in the literature are $ω^{}_{\mathrm{SFF}}$, which controls the onset of random-matrix behavior in the spectral form factor, and the transport frequencies $ω^{}_{\mathrm{tr}}$, which are derived from transport coefficients. However, a direct quantitative comparison of these frequencies is lacking. Using exact diagonalization, we conduct such a comparison for the spectral functions of current operators in clean and disordered quantum spin ladders with diffusive energy and spin transport. We find clear evidence for the expected low-frequency plateaus in the ETH spectral functions. For the accessible system sizes, $ω^{}_{\mathrm{SFF}}$ is consistent with the extent of the plateaus, while the transport frequencies are systematically larger and lie in the nonuniversal regime of the spectral functions. Our findings highlight the need to better understand the origin of these quantitative differences.

AI.tldr: 本文用精确对角化研究量子自旋梯子中电流算符的ETH谱函数，比较其低频平台频率ω_ETH、谱形状因子频率ω_SFF与输运频率ω_tr，发现ω_SFF与平台一致，而ω_tr系统性偏大且位于非普适区。
AI.motivation: ETH谱函数低频谱平台的信息与随机矩阵行为、谱形状因子起始频率ω_SFF及输运系数导出的输运频率ω_tr相关，但三者频率缺乏直接的定量比较。
AI.method: 对清洁和无序量子自旋梯子（具有扩散能量与自旋输运）进行精确对角化，计算电流算符的ETH谱函数，并提取ω_ETH、ω_SFF与ω_tr进行定量对比。
AI.result: 观测到ETH谱函数预期的低频平台；在可及系统尺寸下，ω_SFF与平台范围一致；输运频率系统性更大，落在谱函数的非普适区域。
AI.conclusion: ω_SFF与平台吻合而ω_tr偏大的定量差异提示需进一步理解这些频率差异的起源。

title: Device contacts as spin-state selectors for silicon vacancies in 4H-SiC
summary: Optically addressable defect spins in wide band gap semiconductors are promising building blocks for scalable quantum technologies. Yet, the consequences of conventional contact schemes used in semiconductor device integration for the quantum spin environment remain largely unexplored. Using the silicon vacancy (V$_\mathrm{Si}$) in silicon carbide (SiC) as a model system, we show that a widely used contact metal, nickel (Ni), intrinsically perturbs the defect spin state and quenches the characteristic emission from the spin-quartet channel of V$_\mathrm{Si}$. Low-energy muon spin rotation further reveals that Ni contacts create a magnetically contaminated region extending at least $\sim$120 nm into the SiC, in stark contrast to non-magnetic contacts such as Ti and Al. Moreover, cross-sectional cathodoluminescence measurements conducted on samples with box profiles of high defect density demonstrate a suppression of the quartet-state luminescence from the V$_\mathrm{Si}$ over a distance up to 500 nm beneath the Ni contact. This drastic influence on the defect's magnetic environment is accompanied by the appearance of a signature consistent with photoluminescence from the spin-doublet state of V$_\mathrm{Si}$ in the vicinity of the Ni layer, which was not observed in other material stacks. These results establish that even standard device configurations can drive quantum defects into unwanted charge and spin configurations, underscoring the necessity of precise design to preserve quantum-grade spin environments in semiconductor devices.

AI.tldr: Ni接触会内在地扰动SiC中硅空位(V_Si)的电子自旋环境并猝灭四重态发光,磁场污染区延伸至少120 nm,发光抑制可达500 nm深,提示器件集成需精细设计以保护量子级自旋环境。
AI.motivation: 宽禁带半导体中的光可寻址缺陷自旋是构建可扩展量子技术的有前景单元,但半导体器件集成中常用接触方案对量子自旋环境的影响尚不清楚。作者以SiC中的V_Si为模型,探究接触金属对量子缺陷自旋环境的破坏效应。
AI.method: 以SiC中V_Si为模型体系;对比磁性金属Ni与Ti、Al等非磁性接触;采用低能μ子自旋旋转(LE-μSR)探测磁污染深度;用横截面阴极发光(CL)测量高缺陷密度样品中四重态发光分布,结合光致发光(PL)识别双态信号。
AI.result: Ni接触内在地扰动V_Si自旋态并猝灭其特征四重态发射;LE-μSR显示Ni引入的磁污染区至少延伸约120 nm进入SiC,而Ti、Al等非磁性接触无此现象;CL显示Ni接触下方500 nm范围内四重态发光被抑制;Ni附近出现与V_Si自旋二重态PL一致的信号,其他材料堆叠未见。
AI.conclusion: 即使标准器件配置也会使量子缺陷进入不良电荷与自旋构型,表明在半导体器件中保持量子级自旋环境需要精确的器件设计。

title: Staged emergence of anomalous Hall transport in a correlated uranium Weyl semimetal
summary: Understanding how electronic correlations reshape topological states remains a central challenge in quantum materials. Here we investigate the uranium ferromagnet UPS using magnetotransport, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, thermodynamic measurements, and first principles calculations. Resonant photoemission reveals narrow U-$5f$ spectral weight at the Fermi level coexisting with broad incoherent states, consistent with the itinerant/localized duality characteristic of uranium $5f$ electrons. The anomalous Hall conductivity reaches approximately $4.5\times10^{2}\,Ω^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, yet does not simply follow the ordered magnetic moment. Temperature dependent photoemission reveals relatively little change across $T_C=118$~K, followed by a pronounced redistribution of low-energy $5f$ spectral weight below approximately 90~K. First-principles calculations identify a symmetry protected Weyl crossing with pronounced Berry curvature and yield an intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity of approximately $9.6\times10^{2}\,Ω^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$. These results demonstrate that magnetic order, correlated electronic reconstruction, and anomalous Hall transport develop over distinct but overlapping temperature ranges, revealing how strong correlations reshape topological transport in a uranium Weyl semimetal.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合磁输运、ARPES、热力学测量和第一性原理计算研究铀铁磁体UPS，揭示强电子关联如何重塑拓扑输运。
AI.motivation: 理解电子关联如何重塑拓扑态是量子材料研究的核心挑战，铀5f电子的巡游/局域二重性使这一问题尤为关键。
AI.method: 采用磁输运、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）、共振光电子能谱、热力学测量与第一性原理计算相结合的多手段研究。
AI.result: 共振光电子谱显示费米能级处存在窄的U-5f谱权重与宽的非相干态共存；反常霍尔电导约4.5×10² Ω⁻¹cm⁻¹，不简单跟随有序磁矩；Tc=118 K附近变化小，约90 K以下低能5f谱权重显著重分布。第一性原理计算识别出对称保护Weyl交叉及显著Berry曲率，给出约9.6×10² Ω⁻¹cm⁻¹的本征反常霍尔电导。
AI.conclusion: 磁有序、关联电子重构与反常霍尔输运在彼此不同但重叠的温区发展，揭示强关联如何重塑铀Weyl半金属的拓扑输运。

title: Collective Coordinate Dynamics of Antiferromagnet: Gravity by Quantum Metric
summary: The collective coordinate dynamics of antiferromagnetic and ferrimagnetic textures emerges as a geodesic equation governed by the quantum geometry of the CP$^1$ state associated with the Néel vector, rendering an effective Riemannian gravity and a Lorentz force in the texture motion. This unveils a physical scenario fundamentally distinct from the Thiele equation widely used for ferromagnetic textures, which is inertialess without any gravity analogy. Applying our framework to an optically driven ultrafast antiferromagnetic domain wall, we can explain the helicity-dependent asymmetric motion observed experimentally and predict a vibrantly breathing wall width.

AI.tldr: 反铁磁/亚铁磁织构的集体坐标动力学由Néel矢量CP¹态量子几何支配，表现为测地线方程，产生有效黎曼引力和洛伦兹力，与铁磁中的Thiele方程根本不同。
AI.motivation: 铁磁织构动力学长期由无惯性的Thiele方程描述，缺乏引力类比，无法统一描述反铁磁和亚铁磁织构的惯性运动；需要建立新框架解释其集体坐标动力学。
AI.method: 从Néel矢量关联的CP¹态量子几何出发，将反铁磁与亚铁磁织构的集体坐标动力学推导为测地线方程，映射出有效黎曼引力及洛伦兹力。
AI.result: 框架应用于光驱动的超快反铁磁畴壁，成功解释实验观察到的螺旋性依赖的非对称运动，并预测畴壁宽度会剧烈呼吸式振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了区别于铁磁Thiele图像的新物理机制，为反铁磁/亚铁磁织构动力学提供统一几何描述，并给出可验证的预测。

title: From Local Atomic Motifs to Thermodynamic State: An Interpretable Physics-Informed Framework for Cu-Zr Metallic Glasses
summary: Machine-learning models that relate local atomic structure to the thermodynamic state of metallic glasses typically assess physical consistency after training rather than enforcing it during learning. Here, we develop a multi-task physics-informed neural network (PINN) that predicts temperature directly from Voronoi-motif population histograms while incorporating autograd-derived gradient constraints representing physically motivated relationships between structural motifs, quench rate, and temperature. The model simultaneously classifies each configuration as liquid, supercooled/transition, or glass through an auxiliary classification head. The classification task achieves 96.6% test accuracy with a macro-F1 score of 0.95, while the regression head yields a mean absolute error of 23.4 K on a trajectory-disjoint held-out test set. Five-fold trajectory-grouped cross-validation, deep-ensemble predictions, and Monte Carlo dropout are used to assess model robustness and predictive uncertainty. Sensitivity analyses demonstrate that physics constraints can be incorporated over a broad range of loss weights without compromising predictive accuracy, while substantially improving compliance with the prescribed physical trends. Benchmarking against conventional machine-learning regressors further demonstrates competitive predictive performance. SHAP analysis across the cross-validation ensemble identifies the coupled near-icosahedral motif family, particularly the full icosahedral motif and its single-atom-perturbed counterpart, as the dominant structural fingerprints of the glassy state. These results demonstrate that physically motivated constraints can be embedded directly into motif-based structure-property models, providing a pathway from post-hoc interpretability toward physically constrained machine learning for metallic glasses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多任务物理信息神经网络（PINN），从Voronoi基元分布直方图直接预测金属玻璃的温度，并分类液态/过冷/玻璃态，兼顾物理约束与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习模型通常只在训练后评估物理一致性，而非在训练过程中强制约束，缺乏物理可解释性与一致性。
AI.method: 构建多任务PINN：回归头从Voronoi基元群体直方图预测温度，并加入基于自动微分的梯度约束（结构基元、淬火速率与温度关系）；辅助分类头判别液态/过冷/玻璃态。采用轨迹分组五折交叉验证、深度集成与MC dropout评估鲁棒性和不确定性，并用SHAP分析特征重要性。
AI.result: 分类测试准确率96.6%，macro-F1为0.95；回归MAE为23.4 K（轨迹不相交测试集）。物理约束在宽泛损失权重范围内不损害精度且显著提升物理趋势符合度，性能与常规回归器相当。SHAP识别出近二十面体基元族（尤其完整二十面体及其单原子扰动对应体）为玻璃态主导结构指纹。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束可直接嵌入基于基元的结构-性质模型，为金属玻璃从后验可解释性走向物理约束机器学习提供路径。

title: Optimal probing scale for current fluctuations in a Brownian gyrator
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22877097
summary: A driven colloidal rotor sustains a circulating current whose fluctuations one would like to bound. Any such bound rests on how strongly the current responds to a perturbation and on how much extra dissipation that perturbation costs, so there is a well-posed question of where to push: the response per unit Onsager-Machlup cost depends on the radius at which the probe acts, and is maximised at a definite one. We answer this for the Brownian gyrator and a quadrupolar shear under a Gaussian envelope, a probe chosen so that linear response is exactly blind to it at every observation window, so that the entire signal is second order. The problem separates: the cost is radial and does not see the circulation, while the response lives in the $m=3$ angular sector, where the resolvent reduces to Kummer's equation with $b=4$ and the susceptibility is a hypergeometric function of the envelope width. Maximising the ratio gives the optimal probing radius in closed form. It is set by whichever of the system's two clocks is faster: for weak driving $r^*=1.1264\sqrt{D/γ}$, the thermal radius of the trap, and for strong driving $r^*=1.5563\sqrt{D/Ω}$, the distance diffused in one radian of rotation, with the trap stiffness dropping out entirely. The crossover is at $Ω=γ$. Both limits, and the prefactors, are confirmed against direct simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何对布朗转子（Brownian gyrator）与四极剪切下的持续电流进行最优探测，发现响应/单位Onsager-Machlup代价在特定半径处最大，并给出该最优半径的闭式解。
AI.motivation: 电流涨落的上界依赖于响应强度与扰动额外耗散的权衡，而探测半径不同会使该权衡发生变化，因此需要找到最优探测半径。
AI.method: 考虑布朗转子与高斯包络下的四极剪切，选取线性响应完全"看不见"的探针（信号全为二阶），将代价（径向、与环流无关）与响应（m=3角扇区，其resolvent化为b=4的Kummer方程，磁化率为包络宽度的超几何函数）分离处理，并最大化二者之比。
AI.result: 最优探测半径由系统两个时钟中较快者决定：弱驱动时 r*=1.1264√(D/γ)（陷阱热半径），强驱动时 r*=1.5563√(D/Ω)（旋转一弧度扩散距离，陷阱刚度完全消失），交叉点在Ω=γ；两极限及前因子均经直接模拟验证。
AI.conclusion: 最优探针半径存在闭式解，并随驱动强弱由两类物理尺度切换，理论预因子与数值模拟一致。

title: Perspective: The HSE Screened Hybrid and the Band Gap Problem: Origins, Impact, and the Contenders
summary: The ideas behind the screened hybrid functional HSE took shape in the early 2000s, about a quarter century ago. HSE was not explicitly designed to predict band gaps, although at the time we did recognize that hybrids could help address the band-gap problem. It was designed to make exact exchange affordable and physically defensible in extended systems. Keeping exact exchange at short range and screening it away at long range inverted the prescription developed for molecules. When HSE band gaps for ordinary semiconductors and selected metal oxides came out substantially closer to experiment than those obtained with conventional semilocal approximations, we were pleasantly surprised and encouraged by the path we had taken. The revision from HSE03 to HSE06 improved molecular thermochemistry while preserving the good accuracy for semiconductor gaps. The one-quarter exchange fraction was inherited unchanged from the successful unscreened PBE hybrid for molecules, rather than fitted to solids. HSE established a practical screened-hybrid approach for accurate band-gap calculations, expanding first-principles work in defect physics, photovoltaics, power electronics, and quantum information, among other areas. The first part of this Perspective recounts the decisions made at HSE's birth and their influence on subsequent developments. The second part assesses recent advances in semilocal and hybrid functionals against benchmarks on sets of solids. Recent meta-GGAs achieve HSE06-level accuracy for selected semiconductors, while dielectric-dependent and tuned hybrids address the limitations of fixed screening. These hybrid developments share with our early work on local hybrids and local range separation the aim of adapting exact exchange to the electronic environment. The comparisons assess band gaps alongside structures, energetics, computational cost, and transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了HSE屏蔽杂化泛函的诞生历程，并评估了当前半局域与杂化泛函在固体基准上的最新进展。
AI.motivation: HSE并非为预测带隙而设计，而是为了让精确交换在延展体系中可行且物理合理。当时希望解决带隙问题并降低杂化泛函在固体中的计算成本。
AI.method: 将精确交换保留在短程、在长程屏蔽，反转了分子体系的设计思路；交换分数沿用PBE杂化泛函的1/4而非拟合固体；从HSE03更新到HSE06以改善分子热化学；并综述介电依赖与调谐杂化等新进展。
AI.result: HSE对普通半导体和部分金属氧化物的带隙显著接近实验值；HSE06保持半导体带隙精度的同时改善了分子热化学。近期meta-GGA在部分半导体上达到HSE06水平，介电依赖与调谐杂化弥补了固定屏蔽的局限。
AI.conclusion: HSE确立了实用的屏蔽杂化方法用于精确带隙计算，推动了缺陷物理、光伏、电力电子和量子信息等领域发展；未来方向是让精确交换适应不同电子环境。

title: Navier-Stokes hydrodynamics near the critical point with out-of-equilibrium modes
summary: We investigate how slow out-of-equilibrium modes (OEM), introduced to extend the regime of validity of hydrodynamics near the critical point, fundamentally reshape the power spectrum of dynamical density fluctuations. We have used the equation of motion of slow modes for the situation when the extensive nature of thermodynamics is not altered due to the introduction of OEM. We find that the extensivity condition puts an extra constraint on the coupling of OEM with the four divergence of velocity. In the absence of OEM, the dynamic structure factor exhibits three Lorentzian peaks, one at zero frequency ($ω$), called Rayleigh peak and the other two called Brillouin peaks located symmetrically about $ω=0$. When the system is away from the critical point the inclusion of the OEM preserves the symmetry of the distributions but all the peaks acquire reduced widths and the Brillouin peaks adopt unequal heights. Irrespective of the value of OEM (zero or nonzero) the Brillouin peaks vanish near the critical point. The width of the Rayleigh peak substantially reduced in presence of OEM. Such reductions of the widths in presence of the OEM indicates the reduction in the decay rate of the fluctuation which leads to slowing down of decay of the fluctuations, a distinctive feature of the critical point.

AI.tldr: 研究慢速非平衡模式(OEM)对临界点附近动态密度涨落功率谱的影响，发现OEM使谱峰变窄、涨落衰减变慢，体现临界减速特征。
AI.motivation: 流体力学在临界点附近有效性受限，需引入慢速非平衡模式(OEM)扩展其适用范围，但OEM如何重塑动态密度涨落的功率谱尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用慢模式的运动方程，在热力学广延性不变的条件下，推导广延性约束对OEM与速度四散度耦合的额外限制，并分析动态结构因子。
AI.result: 无OEM时动态结构因子有三个洛伦兹峰：中心Rayleigh峰和对称的Brillouin峰。远离临界点时，OEM保持分布对称性但使所有峰宽减小、Brillouin峰高度不等；无论OEM是否为零，临界点附近Brillouin峰消失；OEM存在时Rayleigh峰宽度显著减小。
AI.conclusion: 峰宽减小表明涨落衰减率降低，即涨落衰减变慢，这正是临界点临界减速的显著特征。

title: Trade-off between interface morphology and compositional homogeneity in AlGaAs/GaAs quantum wells revealed by multislice electron ptychography
summary: AlGaAs/GaAs asymmetric coupled quantum wells (ACQWs) are promising platforms for enhanced second-order optical nonlinearities, with their performance strongly influenced by the structural quality of heterostructures. Flat interfaces, together with high compositional homogeneity, are generally desirable for optimizing device functionality. Here we show that sharp and flat AlGaAs/GaAs interface morphology dominates the second harmonic generation (SHG) response in AlGaAs/GaAs ACQWs, even when significant compositional fluctuations in Al/Ga occupancy are present within the AlGaAs layers. Using multislice electron ptychography, we resolve the three-dimensional (3D) interface morphology and compositional distribution in AlGaAs/GaAs ACQWs under distinct growth interruptions. Longer growth interruptions sharpen and flatten the AlGaAs/GaAs interfaces, but at the same time cause stronger compositional fluctuations in the AlGaAs layers. These findings clarify how growth interruption tunes quantum wells structures and provide direct guidance for quantum wells design in next-generation optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示AlGaAs/GaAs非对称耦合量子阱中，界面平整度主导二次谐波产生响应，即使AlGaAs层存在组分波动。
AI.motivation: AlGaAs/GaAs非对称耦合量子阱是增强二阶光学非线性的有前景平台，其性能受异质结构质量影响，需明确界面形貌与组分分布对SHG的作用。
AI.method: 采用多层电子叠层成像（multislice electron ptychography）技术，在不同生长中断条件下解析AlGaAs/GaAs ACQWs的三维界面形貌与组分分布。
AI.result: 更长生长中断使AlGaAs/GaAs界面更尖锐平整，但同时导致AlGaAs层内组分波动更强；陡峭平整的界面形貌主导SHG响应。
AI.conclusion: 阐明生长中断对量子阱结构的调控机制，为下一代光电器件的量子阱设计提供直接指导。

title: Revealing tilt-driven structural heterogeneity in hybrid improper ferroelectrics by spatially-resolved crystallography
summary: Domain walls in ferroic oxides can host emergent functionalities that differ fundamentally from those of the surrounding bulk, making their microscopic structure central to understanding and controlling macroscopic behaviour. We use scanning three-dimensional X-ray diffraction to map the spatial evolution of coupled octahedral distortion modes across ferroelastic domain walls in the hybrid improper ferroelectric Ca$_{2.15}$Sr$_{0.85}$Ti$_{2}$O$_{7}$. By combining tomographic reconstruction with symmetry-adapted analysis of the octahedral rotation and tilt and associated strain modes, we map their spatial evolution across individual walls in the bulk crystal. We find that the walls are intrinsically extended, with widths far exceeding those expected for conventional Ising-like ferroic interfaces. The wall structure is characterised by a continuous rotation of the tilt order parameter through a tetragonal intermediate. These results provide new microscopic insight into the structural mechanisms governing ferroelastic wall formation, ferroelectric switching, and emergent functionality at domain walls.

AI.tldr: 利用扫描三维X射线衍射，对杂化非本征铁电体Ca2.15Sr0.85Ti2O7中铁弹畴壁的八面体畸变模式进行空间成像，发现畴壁本质上是很宽的，远超常规Ising型界面，其结构表现为倾斜序参量经四方中间态连续旋转。
AI.motivation: 铁性氧化物畴壁可承载不同于体相的涌现功能，其微观结构对理解与调控宏观行为至关重要，但畴壁内部耦合畸变模式的空间演化尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用扫描三维X射线衍射（scanning 3D XRD），结合层析重建与对称性适配分析，对Ca2.15Sr0.85Ti2O7中八面体旋转、倾斜及相关应变模式在单个畴壁两侧的空间演化进行逐点测绘。
AI.result: 畴壁本质上是扩展的（宽度远大于传统Ising型铁性界面预期），沿壁结构表现为倾斜序参量经四方中间相连续旋转。
AI.conclusion: 研究为铁弹畴壁形成、铁电翻转及畴壁涌现功能的结构机制提供了新的微观认识。

title: Channel concentration of critical quantum geometry
comment: 44 pages, 7 figures (including Supplemental Material); code and data available at https://github.com/ToelUl/channel-concentration/tree/companion-2026-09-21-rc1
summary: The quantum metric quantifies the total ground-state response along a parameter direction, but does not resolve how excitations share that response. We define channel concentration (CC) as the sum of squared normalized response weights over specified excitation channels, such as momentum blocks. An exact finite-size theorem yields thermodynamic CCs of 2/3 for the field response of the critical transverse-field Ising model and 1/3 for the half-filled XX pairing response, despite the same leading metric scaling. In finite-size approaches to the XY Lifshitz point, field and anisotropy perturbations yield different concentrations despite a common limiting Hamiltonian with quadratic dispersion. In a unitary 1+1-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT) on a circle, we consider a nondegenerate vacuum in a fixed sector perturbed by one spatially integrated scalar primary. We derive complete zero-momentum energy-level response weights, including descendants. For scaling dimension $0<Δ<3/2$, these weights determine the normalized response distribution and an exact universal concentration function. The expression reproduces the exact Ising lattice limit 2/3 and gives approximately 0.8515 for the three-state Potts thermal field, compared with approximately 0.800 from an exponent-only approximation. Finite-size interacting calculations compare concentrations and ranked response weights over many-body energy levels. These exact benchmarks show which response distinctions total metric scaling misses and guide comparisons with finite-size interacting spectra.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"通道集中度"(CC)来刻画基态响应在不同激发通道间的分配,揭示总量子度规标度所掩盖的响应差异,并给出精确的有限尺寸定理与CFT普适结果。
AI.motivation: 量子度规只量化沿参数方向的总基态响应,却不区分各激发通道如何分享该响应,因此在总标度相同时仍可能存在重要差异。
AI.method: 定义CC为指定激发通道上归一化响应权重的平方和;用精确有限尺寸定理分析临界横场Ising模型与半填充XX配对响应,并在1+1维CFT圆上由空间积分的标量主算子微扰推导零动量能级响应权重(含后代),得到归一化响应分布与普适集中度函数。
AI.result: 临界横场Ising场响应热力学CC=2/3,半填充XX配对响应CC=1/3,尽管两者主导度规标度相同;XY Lifshitz点处场与各向异性微扰给出不同集中度;CFT中当0<Δ<3/2得到精确普适集中度函数,重现Ising极限2/3,三态Potts热场约0.8515(指数近似约0.800);有限尺寸相互作用计算比较了多体能级上的集中度与排序权重。
AI.conclusion: 这些精确基准揭示了总度规标度遗漏的响应区别,并为与有限尺寸相互作用谱的比较提供指导。

title: Ultralow-Barrier Ion Transport in the Subnitride Electride Ba$_3$N for High-Rate Sodium Storage
summary: Electrides, ionic crystals in which excess electrons are delocalized within interstitial voids rather than bound to specific atomic sites, exhibit exotic physicochemical behaviors, yet their potential as electrochemical energy-storage hosts remains largely unexplored. Here, using comprehensive first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the quasi-one-dimensional subnitride electride Ba$_3$N offers a compelling route to overcome the long-standing performance trade-offs in sodium-ion battery anodes. Spontaneous Na intercalation into the open interchain channels establishes thermodynamically stable phases, generating an exceptionally flat low-potential plateau that avoids the high-potential sloping losses of hard carbon while preserving an essential safety margin against dendrite formation. Crucially, the itinerant interstitial anionic electron sea dynamically flattens the potential landscape by suppressing site-specific orbital interactions, enabling ultrafast Na ion transport with an exceptionally low migration barrier. This work establishes a design paradigm for harnessing electride chemistry to achieve ultrafast battery electrodes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，证明准一维亚氮化物电子化合物Ba₃N可作为高性能钠离子电池负极，兼具平坦低压平台、无枝晶安全性和超快离子传输。
AI.motivation: 电子化合物（excess电子离域于间隙空隙）具有奇特物化性质，但其作为电化学储能主体的潜力尚未被充分探索；同时钠离子电池负极长期存在性能权衡难题。
AI.method: 采用全面的第一性原理计算，研究Ba₃N的电子化合物特性及其电化学储钠行为，分析Na嵌入的热力学稳定性、电压平台及离子迁移势垒。
AI.result: Na自发嵌入开放的链间通道形成热力学稳定相，产生异常平坦的低电位平台，避免硬碳的高电位斜坡损耗并保留防枝晶的安全裕度；游走的间隙阴离子电子海通过抑制位点特异性轨道相互作用动态抚平电势分布，实现超低迁移势垒的超快Na离子传输。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了利用电子化合物化学实现超快电池电极的设计范式。

title: Enhanced thermal conductivity of (010) (AlxGa1-x)2O3 epitaxial films utilizing indium-catalyzed molecular beam epitaxy
summary: (AlxGa1-x)2O3/beta-Ga2O3 transistors are an emerging candidate for high-power and high-frequency electronic devices. beta-Ga2O3 in particular is notably limited for anisotropic low thermal conductivity, which is further reduced in (AlxGa1-x)2O3 due to alloy and other defect-driven phonon scattering mechanisms. In this work we show that the thermal conductivity of (010) oriented (AlxGa1-x)2O3 thin films for 0.01 < x < 0.20, measured using time-domain thermoreflectance (TDTR), is limited by alloy scattering without observable adverse scattering by additional defects. This is enabled through the synthesis of the (AlxGa1-x)2O3 films using molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) on \b{eta}-Ga2O3 substrates, leveraging indium-catalyzed growth to suppress dislocation formation and phase separation to achieve single-phase pseudomorphic films up to x = 0.2. This growth process improved the thermal conductivity of (AlxGa1-x)2O3 by 2X as compared to previously reported values. For increasing Al composition (x), we observe a steady decline in (AlxGa1-x)2O3 thermal conductivity due to alloy scattering which is validated using virtual crystal approximation (VCA) model. We also show that the thermal boundary conductance across the Al/(AlxGa1-x)2O3 interface is reduced with increasing x, which we posit is due to the stiffening of the (AlxGa1-x)2O3 acoustic modes with increasing x by comparing experimental results with a diffuse mismatch model (DMM). Overall, these thermal characteristics provide valuable insights for designing heterostructures with optimized interfaces and composition.

AI.tldr: 通过MBE铟催化生长实现高质量(AlxGa1-x)2O3薄膜，热导率受合金散射限制，较此前提升2倍。
AI.motivation: (AlxGa1-x)2O3/beta-Ga2O3晶体管是高功率高频电子器件的新兴候选，但beta-Ga2O3热导率低且各向异性，(AlxGa1-x)2O3因合金及缺陷驱动的声子散射进一步降低热导率，限制了器件性能。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延(MBE)在beta-Ga2O3衬底上生长(AlxGa1-x)2O3薄膜，利用铟催化生长抑制位错和相分离，实现x=0.2以下的单相赝晶薄膜；用时域热反射(TDTR)测量0.01<x<0.20范围(010)取向薄膜热导率，并用虚拟晶体近似(VCA)和漫散射失配模型(DMM)进行验证。
AI.result: 热导率仅受合金散射限制，无额外缺陷散射；较此前报道热导率提升2倍；随Al组分x增加热导率稳定下降，VCA模型验证了合金散射机制；Al/(AlxGa1-x)2O3界面热边界导随x增加而降低，DMM对比表明源于(AlxGa1-x)2O3声学模随x增加而变硬。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了(AlxGa1-x)2O3薄膜的热特性，为设计具有优化界面的异质结构提供了重要参考。

title: Quantum Mpemba effect from Stark localization
summary: In classical systems, rugged potential energy landscapes provide a transparent mechanism for the celebrated Mpemba effect, in which hotter initial states cool down faster. This picture generally does not survive in quantum systems. Here we show how to design a quantum energy landscape with local dissipation leading to an Mpemba effect with parametrically separated timescales. Our approach uses Stark localization to design an energy landscape and localized incoherent hopping as cooling mechanism. The hops are triggered by rare "detection" events whose rate grows with energy, allowing hotter states to cool faster and producing super-exponentially separated cooling rates for localized initial states. We further show that the effect is dramatically enhanced by collective hopping of bound pairs in the presence of attractive on-site interactions. These findings have clear experimental signatures accessible in present-day setups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用斯塔克局域化设计量子能景、并由局域非相干跳跃驱动冷却的方案，实现具有参数分离时间尺度的量子姆潘巴效应。
AI.motivation: 经典系统中崎岖势能面可解释姆潘巴效应（更热的初态冷却更快），但这一图像在量子系统中通常不成立，因此需要新的机制来在量子体系实现该效应。
AI.method: 采用斯塔克局域化设计能量景观，以局域非相干跳跃作为冷却机制；跳跃由稀有"探测"事件触发，其速率随能量增大。进一步考虑吸引型在位相互作用下束缚对的集体跳跃。
AI.result: 更热的态冷却更快，局域初态的冷却速率呈现超指数分离；吸引型在位相互作用使束缚对集体跳跃显著增强该效应，并在现有实验平台中具有可观测特征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一种可设计的量子姆潘巴机制，将斯塔克局域化与局域耗散结合，并预测了近期实验可检验的特征。

title: Sapphire-Side hBN Formation by Ni--Cr-Mediated Growth in a Stacked Ni--Cr/Boron/Sapphire Configuration: Effect of Boron Supply
summary: Metal-mediated growth provides an effective route to high-quality hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), but hBN formation on the metal does not necessarily ensure hBN formation on an adjoining dielectric substrate. Here, we investigate this distinction using a vertically stacked Ni--Cr/boron/sapphire configuration operated at 1550~$^\circ$C under atmospheric pressure, with the relative boron supply varied at fixed Ni:Cr = 8:2. hBN is detected by Raman spectroscopy on the gas-exposed alloy surface throughout the investigated Alloy:B range, whereas sapphire-side hBN appears only at the higher relative boron supplies of Alloy:B = 24:1 and 18:1, as confirmed by both Raman spectroscopy and XRD. The hBN (002) reflection further narrows as the boron supply increases from 24:1 to 18:1, corresponding to an increase in the apparent c-axis coherent length from approximately 86 to 143~nm. Additional crystalline reflections also emerge only under these higher-boron conditions. These results identify boron supply as a key parameter governing the transition from alloy-side hBN formation to concurrent sapphire-side hBN growth. Once formed, sapphire-side hBN occurs within a substantially reconstructed and chemically modified Al/O-rich sapphire environment rather than as a uniform film on an intact substrate. To our knowledge, this study provides the first demonstration of successful sapphire-side hBN formation by Ni--Cr-mediated growth.

AI.tldr: 通过垂直堆叠Ni-Cr/硼/蓝宝石体系在1550°C常压下生长hBN，发现硼供给量是决定hBN能否从合金侧扩展到蓝宝石侧的关键参数，并首次实现Ni-Cr介导的蓝宝石侧hBN生长。
AI.motivation: 金属介导生长可制备高质量hBN，但金属上形成hBN并不意味着相邻介电衬底上也能形成hBN，二者之间的区别与调控机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用垂直堆叠的Ni-Cr/硼/蓝宝石构型，在1550°C、常压下运行，固定Ni:Cr=8:2，改变相对硼供给量；用Raman光谱和XRD表征两侧hBN。
AI.result: 在整个Alloy:B范围内气体暴露的合金表面均检测到hBN；蓝宝石侧hBN仅在较高硼供给（Alloy:B=24:1和18:1）时出现。随硼供给从24:1增至18:1，hBN(002)反射变窄，c轴相干长度从约86 nm增至143 nm，并出现额外晶态反射。
AI.conclusion: 硼供给是控制从合金侧hBN形成向蓝宝石侧同步生长的关键参数；蓝宝石侧hBN形成于显著重构且化学改性的富Al/O蓝宝石环境中，而非完整衬底上的均匀薄膜。该工作首次证明Ni-Cr介导生长可实现蓝宝石侧hBN形成。

title: Deterministic control of antiferromagnetic domain walls by circular phonons
summary: In an antiferromagnet, areas with different orientations of the antiferromagnetic Néel vector, which plays the role of the order parameter, can coexist, thus forming antiferromagnetic domains separated by domain walls. This suggests that antiferromagnets can possess the functionalities of magnetic storage media. Whether one can benefit from these functionalities crucially depends on the availability of efficient means for deterministic control of antiferromagnetic domain walls. Here, we demonstrate an approach to deterministically control domain walls in the van der Waals antiferromagnet Ni-doped $MnPS_3$ via dynamic engineering of the crystal lattice. By resonantly exciting a pair of nearly degenerate orthogonal infrared-active $A_u$ and $B_u$ phonon modes with circularly polarized mid-infrared light, we induce helicity-dependent reconfiguration of 180° antiferromagnetic domains, providing evidence for a phonon-induced effective field conjugate to the Néel order parameter. The domain kinetics exhibit a pronounced helicity asymmetry governed by the interplay between domain-wall elasticity and defect-mediated pinning, enabling small phonon-driven perturbations to accumulate into stable domain transformations. Our results establish dynamic lattice control and defect engineering as means for deterministic control of antiferromagnetic order.

AI.tldr: 通过圆偏振中红外光共振激发近简并的正交红外活性声子模式，在Ni掺杂MnPS₃反铁磁体中实现了对180°反铁磁畴壁的确定性控制。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体中不同奈尔矢量取向的区域可共存形成畴与畴壁，使其具备磁存储潜力，但能否利用该功能取决于是否存在高效、确定性地控制反铁磁畴壁的手段。
AI.method: 在范德华反铁磁体Ni掺杂MnPS₃中，利用圆偏振中红外光共振激发一对近简并的正交红外活性A_u与B_u声子模式，通过晶格动力学工程诱导螺旋度依赖的180°反铁磁畴重构。
AI.result: 观察到螺旋度依赖的畴重构，证明存在与奈尔序参量共轭的声子诱导有效场；畴动力学表现出显著的螺旋度不对称性，由畴壁弹性与缺陷介导钉扎之间的相互作用主导，使微小声子扰动累积为稳定的畴转变。
AI.conclusion: 动态晶格控制与缺陷工程可作为确定性控制反铁磁序的有效手段。

title: Dual Role of Mobile Interstitials in Defect Kinetics: From Retardation to Acceleration
summary: Mobile interstitial atoms redistribute while defects migrate, complicating prediction of defect kinetics and leading to contradictory reports of acceleration and retardation. We formulate defect activation in a grand-canonical ensemble at fixed interstitial chemical potential and define a pathway free-energy landscape $ΔG(Λ;T,μ)$ and the corresponding activation free energy $ΔG^{\ddagger}$. We compute these quantities using both hyperplane-constrained thermodynamic integration via a mean force relation and a two-state chemical-potential integration, denoted TSCPI. The latter requires sampling only the initial and transition states; a single chemical-potential integration then yields $ΔG^{\ddagger}(T,μ)$ across a wide $μ$ range, enabling rapid mapping over temperature and chemical potential. Applied to vacancy diffusion in FCC, BCC, and HCP metals with H (including in plane and cross plane diffusion in Zr) and in BCC W with He, both free energy routes agree with diffusion coefficients from molecular dynamics mean square displacements. The resulting maps reveal regimes of suppression and enhancement, including a crossover from suppression to enhancement with increasing hydrogen concentration. A site occupancy analysis links barrier shifts to state dependent site spectrum changes and transferable interstitial interaction terms.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在固定间隙原子化学势下用巨正则系综描述缺陷激活，定义自由能景观ΔG(Λ;T,μ)与激活自由能ΔG‡，并用超平面约束热力学积分和两态化学势积分(TSCPI)两种方法计算，揭示间隙原子对缺陷扩散的抑制/增强规律。
AI.motivation: 移动的间隙原子在缺陷迁移过程中重新分布，使缺陷动力学预测复杂化，并导致关于加速与减速的矛盾报道。传统方法难以在宽温度和化学势范围内高效、统一地描述这一现象。
AI.method: 在固定间隙化学势的巨正则系综中构建缺陷激活的自由能景观ΔG(Λ;T,μ)及激活自由能ΔG‡。采用两种途径计算：(1) 通过平均力关系的超平面约束热力学积分；(2) 两态化学势积分(TSCPI)，仅需采样初态与过渡态，一次化学势积分即可获得宽μ范围的ΔG‡(T,μ)。应用于FCC、BCC、HCP金属中的空位扩散含H（含Zr面内与跨面扩散）以及BCC W含He体系。
AI.result: 两种自由能方法与分子动力学均方位移得到的扩散系数一致。所得映射图揭示抑制与增强的不同区域，并发现随氢浓度增加从抑制到增强的交叉转变。位点占据分析将势垒移动与态依赖的位点谱变化及可迁移的间隙相互作用项关联起来。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个在固定间隙化学势下高效预测缺陷激活自由能的框架，可快速绘制温度-化学势空间中的扩散行为图谱，统一解释间隙原子对缺陷扩散的抑制与增强效应及其交叉机制。

title: Phase field modelling of microstructure transformations in Zr-Sn alloy during irradiation
summary: In this work we study peculiarities of spatial rearrangement of solute and vacancy concentrations in Zr-Sn alloy at stages of both thermal treatment of solid solution and irradiation of annealed alloy under reactor conditions. To this end, we exploit phase field modelling including reaction rate theory and CALPHAD method combined in one generalized approach. Simulations were done in 3D in order to get a detailed information about rearrangement of solutes and defects in a bulk. We discuss the emergence of the secondary phase at the stage of thermal treatment and its stability under neutron irradiation. We analyze an influence of the irradiation dose onto statistical properties of the secondary phase particles.

AI.tldr: 本研究用相场模拟结合反应速率理论与CALPHAD，3D研究Zr-Sn合金在热处理与辐照下溶质和空位的空间重排及第二相演化。
AI.motivation: 理解Zr-Sn合金在热处理和反应堆辐照条件下溶质与空位浓度空间重排的规律，以及第二相的形成与稳定性。
AI.method: 相场建模，融合反应速率理论与CALPHAD方法于统一框架，进行3D模拟以获得体相中溶质与缺陷重排的详细信息。
AI.result: 模拟讨论了热处理阶段第二相的出现及其在中子辐照下的稳定性，并分析了辐照剂量对第二相颗粒统计性质的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该通用化相场方法可揭示Zr-Sn合金中第二相在热处理与辐照下的演化及辐照剂量对颗粒统计特征的作用。

title: Tailoring structural, electronic, optical, and magnetic properties of rare-earth gallates RGaO$_3$ (R = Ho, Er, Tm) via first-principles investigations
summary: Ab initio calculations of cubic perovskites RGaO$_3$ (R = Ho, Er, Tm) were performed using the full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) method within the framework of density functional theory (DFT). We investigated their structural, electronic, magnetic, and optical properties in detail. In the optimized configurations, the lattice constants ranged from 3.83 to 3.85 A. The electronic band structures indicate that ErGaO$_3$ is semiconducting, whereas HoGaO$_3$ and TmGaO$_3$ exhibit half-metallic behavior, probably due to the interaction of spin-orbit coupling with the electronic states near the Fermi level. Optical response of half-metallic compounds (HoGaO$_3$,TmGaO$_3$) is strongly governed by their spin polarization electronic structure. The semiconducting spin channel absorbs ultraviolet photons, while metallic or small gap channel interacts with infrared light. This dual behavior enables spin selective optical excitation, relevant for spintronics and optoelectronics applications. These compounds show high surface reflectivity, with TmGaO$_3$ achieving a maximum reflectivity of 69%. Moreover, their optical conductivity mainly occurs at higher energies, indicating suitability for high-energy optoelectronic applications. The calculated magnetic moments suggest a robust ferromagnetic character across this series.

AI.tldr: 本文采用FP-LAPW方法在DFT框架下计算了立方钙钛矿RGaO₃(R=Ho,Er,Tm)的结构、电子、磁性和光学性质，揭示其半导体/半金属行为及自旋选择光学响应。
AI.motivation: 探索RGaO₃系列钙钛矿的电子与磁学特性，特别是半金属行为及自旋相关光学性质，为自旋电子学和光电子学应用提供理论依据。
AI.method: 使用全势线性缀加平面波(FP-LAPW)方法，在密度泛函理论(DFT)框架下对立方钙钛矿RGaO₃(R=Ho,Er,Tm)进行从头计算，研究其结构、电子、磁性和光学性质。
AI.result: 优化晶格常数介于3.83–3.85 Å；ErGaO₃为半导体，HoGaO₃和TmGaO₃表现为半金属（可能与自旋轨道耦合有关）。半金属化合物的光学响应受自旋极化电子结构主导：半导体自旋通道吸收紫外光子，金属/窄带隙通道与红外光作用，实现自旋选择光学激发。化合物表面反射率高，TmGaO₃最高达69%；光学电导主要发生在高能区；磁矩显示稳健的铁磁性。
AI.conclusion: RGaO₃系列具有半导体/半金属双行为、高反射率和强铁磁性，适合自旋电子学与高能光电子学应用。

title: Computational investigation of a perovskite LaBiO$_{3}$ for photovoltaic, thermoelectric, and optoelectronic applications
summary: Using density functional theory (DFT) with the ONCVVPSP pseudopotential and PBE functional, this study investigates the structural, electronic, elastic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of the trigonal LaBiO$_{3}$ perovskite oxide (space group R3c). Ground-state parameters lattice constant, volume, bulk modulus, and its pressure derivative were determined using the equation of state. Applying the Hubbard correction (GGA+U) revealed an indirect, wide band gap of 3.51 eV. Mechanical properties, including the anisotropy factor, elastic modulus, and Poisson's ratio, were calculated via the Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging scheme. The bulk-to-shear modulus ratio identifies the trigonal phase as ductile. Additionally, Debye temperatures and sound velocities were computed. Optical characteristics (absorption coefficient, refractive index, and electron energy loss function) were evaluated across a 0-35 eV spectral range. Finally, semi-classical transport coefficients, including electrical conductivity, Seebeck coefficient, and power factor, were calculated to assess the material's thermoelectric potential.

AI.tldr: 用DFT+U研究三方相LaBiO₃钙钛矿的结构、电子、弹性、光学与热电性质，得到3.51 eV间接带隙，材料表现为韧性，并评估了其光学与热电潜力。
AI.motivation: 研究三方相LaBiO₃钙钛矿氧化物的多功能物理性质，填补其在弹性、光学与热电方面系统研究的空白。
AI.method: 采用DFT，使用ONCVVPSP赝势与PBE泛函，结合状态方程求基态参数，并施加Hubbard修正(GGA+U)；用Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均计算力学性质，在0-35 eV范围计算光学性质，用半经典方法求输运系数。
AI.result: GGA+U给出约3.51 eV的间接宽带隙；弹性分析表明该三方相为韧性材料，并给出各向异性因子、弹性模量、泊松比、德拜温度与声速；同时得到吸收系数、折射率、电子能量损失谱及电导率、塞贝克系数、功率因子。
AI.conclusion: 三方相LaBiO₃具有宽带隙、韧性力学行为及潜在的光学与热电应用价值，为其后续功能器件设计提供理论参考。

title: Electronic energy structure and optical properties of In$_{4}$CdI$_{6}$ from $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations
summary: This work presents the $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations of the electronic energy spectrum of the In$_{4}$CdI$_{6}$ compound. The study was conducted within the framework of density functional theory (DFT), using local density approximation (LDA) and general gradient approximation (GGA) pseudopotentials, and the Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) hybrid functional. The GGA approximation was implemented using the PBE and PBEsol exchange-correlation functional. Based on the electronic energy structure, the type of the minimum band gap was determined, and an analysis of the energy level dispersion for both the valence and conduction bands was performed. Furthermore, the effective masses of electrons ($\textit{m}_{c}$) and holes ($\textit{m}_{v}$) for In$_{4}$CdI$_{6}$ were established. The energy band analysis was complemented by the calculation of the density of states (DOS). Based on the electronic energy spectrum, the real and imaginary components of the dielectric function are calculated. Using the Kramers-Kronig relations, we also derive such fundamental optical functions of In$_{4}$CdI$_{6}$ as the refractive index $\textit{n}$, and the extinction coefficient $\textit{k}$.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理DFT计算In4CdI6的电子能谱，确定带隙类型、有效质量、态密度及介电函数和光学函数。
AI.motivation: 针对In4CdI6这一化合物的电子与光学性质缺乏系统理论认识，需要从第一性原理层面获取其能带结构及光学响应。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论，使用LDA与GGA（PBE、PBEsol）赝势及HSE06杂化泛函计算电子能谱；由能带结构确定最小带隙类型、分析价带与导带色散，计算电子和空穴有效质量及态密度；再基于电子能谱计算介电函数的实部与虚部，并通过Kramers-Kronig关系导出折射率n和消光系数k。
AI.result: 获得了In4CdI6的最小带隙类型、价带与导带色散特征、电子与空穴有效质量、态密度，以及介电函数的实部和虚部，并进一步得到折射率n和消光系数k。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统给出了In4CdI6的电子能带与光学性质的第一性原理结果，为该材料的光电应用提供了理论参考。

title: A small-distortion geometric model for elasto-plasticity in single crystals driven by the motion of dislocations
summary: A central problem in nonlinear elasto-plasticity theory is to formulate a geometrically nonlinear, large-strain model of elasto-plasticity in single crystals in which plastic flow is driven directly by the motion of dislocations and which allows for a homogenization procedure from discrete dislocation lines to dislocation densities. In this work, such a model is introduced based on two hypotheses: (1) The Small-Distortion Hypothesis posits that the total plastic distortion may be arbitrarily large but its dominant part admits a representation as a gradient, meaning that the distorting effect of dislocations is small relative to the specimen size. Concretely, this hypothesis is realized here through a "multiplicative Helmholtz-type decomposition", which splits an arbitrary matrix field into the product of a gradient and a matrix field with controlled curl. (2) The Line-Tension Approximation treats all dislocations as infinitesimally thin lines whose local stress fields are individually negligible compared to specimen-scale stresses and only matter in the aggregate. The resulting model, termed the Small-Distortion Geometric Model, furthermore employs the so-called Space-Time Framework, which furnishes a geometric language to precisely describe the advection of dislocation lines. As such, it provides a physically grounded account of crystal plasticity in an idealized mesoscopic setting that bridges dislocation mechanics and continuum elasto-plasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"小畸变几何模型"，将单晶大应变弹塑性建模建立在位错运动直接驱动塑性流动的几何框架上，实现从离散位错线到位错密度的均质化。
AI.motivation: 非线性弹塑性理论的核心难题：如何建立既几何非线性、大应变，又由位错运动直接驱动塑性流动，并支持从离散位错线到连续位错密度均质化的单晶弹塑性模型。
AI.method: 基于两条假设：(1) 小畸变假设——总塑性畸变可任意大，但其主导部分可表示为梯度，通过"乘性Helmholtz型分解"将任意矩阵场分解为梯度与受控旋度矩阵场之积；(2) 线张力近似——将位错视为无限细线，其局部应力场可忽略，仅在集总意义上起作用。并结合时空框架精确描述位错线的对流。
AI.result: 构建出"小畸变几何模型"，在理想化介观尺度下给出晶体塑性的物理自洽描述，衔接了位错力学与连续介质弹塑性。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为几何非线性单晶弹塑性提供了统一的几何语言与均质化途径，作为连接位错力学与连续弹塑性的介观桥梁具有理论价值。

title: Ferroelectric switching of odd-parity magnon spin splitting
summary: Magnetic symmetry can lift spin degeneracy in momentum space without producing net magnetization, generating spin textures classified by their parity under momentum reversal. Even-parity textures have well established in altermagnets. Odd-parity spin textures have recently emerged in electronic bands of compensated magnets, but their counterpart in collective bosonic excitations remains experimentally unresolved. Magnons provide a natural setting for this extension because they carry spin angular momentum through insulating magnets without accompanying charge flow. Beyond realizing this missing state, a broader challenge is to program spin splitting with voltage at room temperature. Here we report room-temperature transport evidence for ferroelectric switching odd-parity magnon spin splitting in multiferroic BiFeO3. Symmetry analysis and spin-wave calculations reveal that the cycloidal chirality splits opposite-spin magnon branches with an odd-in-momentum dependence and sets the sign. Experimentally, an injected in-plane-polarized spin current generates an out-of-plane magnon spin component during propagation. This component exhibits the crystalline angular dependence predicted by theory and reverses upon ferroelectric switching, providing a transport fingerprint of the spin-split magnon state. We use the programmed magnon spin to drive deterministic field-free switching of a perpendicular ferromagnet and demonstrate XNOR logic-in-memory. Our results extend odd-parity spin splitting from fermionic electronic states to bosonic collective modes and establish nonvolatile electrical control at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温多铁BiFeO₃中通过输运证据报道了铁电可控的奇宇称磁振子自旋劈裂，将奇宇称自旋劈裂从费米子电子态扩展到玻色子集体激发模式。
AI.motivation: 磁对称性可在无净磁化下解除自旋简并，产生奇/偶宇称自旋织构。偶宇称已在交错磁体中确立，奇宇称在补偿磁体的电子能带中出现，但其在集体玻色激发（磁振子）中的对应态尚无实验证据；此外室温下用电压编程自旋劈裂仍是挑战。
AI.method: 采用对称性分析与自旋波计算揭示摆线手性如何劈裂相反自旋磁振子支并确定符号；通过输运实验，注入面内极化自旋流，观察传播过程中产生的面外磁振子自旋分量及其晶体角度依赖与铁电翻转响应。
AI.result: 面外磁振子自旋分量呈现理论预言的晶体角度依赖，并在铁电翻转时反向；利用编程的磁振子自旋实现垂直铁磁体的确定性无场翻转及XNOR逻辑忆阻计算。
AI.conclusion: 结果将奇宇称自旋劈裂从费米子电子态扩展到玻色子集体模，并确立了室温下的非易失电控。

title: Ultrahigh Thermal Conductivity in Isotopically Ultrapure Single-Crystal Diamond
summary: Diamond has the highest thermal conductivity among natural materials. Reducing isotope scattering can further push the limit of thermal conductivity of diamond. Here, we report the room-temperature thermal conductivity of a diamond single crystal with an exceptionally low ppm-level 13C content. Secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) reveals a 13C concentration of only ~0.00024% and negligible other impurities, placing this sample as the most isotopically purified diamond samples reported to date. Time-domain thermoreflectance measurements show a room-temperature thermal conductivity of ~3100 W m-1 K-1. Although this value is markedly higher than that of natural diamond, it remains comparable to the best reported values for less isotopically 12C pure diamond. This result suggests that additional phonon-scattering mechanisms beyond isotope scattering may exist at this extreme isotopic purification level. Vacancy defects may contribute to the remaining suppression of thermal conductivity.

AI.tldr: 通过极低13C含量(~0.00024%)的金刚石单晶，实现室温热导率~3100 W/mK，虽高于天然金刚石，但仍与最佳12C纯化样品相当，暗示存在同位素散射之外的声子散射机制。
AI.motivation: 金刚石是天然热导率最高的材料，减少同位素散射有望进一步提升其热导率极限，因此需要制备并测量极高同位素纯度的金刚石。
AI.method: 采用二次离子质谱(SIMS)表征13C浓度及杂质；对极低13C含量(~0.00024%)的金刚石单晶使用时域热反射(TDTR)测量室温热导率。
AI.result: 样品为迄今同位素纯化程度最高的金刚石；测得室温热导率约3100 W m-1 K-1，明显高于天然金刚石，但与最佳12C纯化金刚石报道值相当。
AI.conclusion: 在极端同位素纯化水平下，可能存在同位素散射之外的额外声子散射机制（如空位缺陷），导致热导率未能进一步突破。

title: Electronic-Entropy-Driven Phase Transitions in Compressed Iron Oxides
summary: Electronic entropy is usually treated as a secondary correction to structural stability, but under strong electronic excitation it can become a primary thermodynamic driving force. Here we show that electronic entropy can drive both polymorphic and stoichiometric phase transformations in compressed iron oxides.
